AI.practical_contributions: 为印度汽车行业劳动力市场政策提供实证依据，表明提高合同工工资的关键在于提升其生产率而非单纯改变市场结构

title: From Home to Law: Addressing Domestic Abuse and Inheritance Inequality among Transgender Persons in Kashmir

detail.title: From Home to Law: Addressing Domestic Abuse and Inheritance Inequality among Transgender Persons in Kashmir
detail.abstract:
Abstract

This policy note examines the family and inheritance aspect of transgender lives in Kashmir. Drawing from 14 in- depth interviews of transgender persons conducted in different periods from October 2023 to May 2025 depending on participant availability. The Policy note reflects on the themes of family, inheritance, belonging and exclusion of transgender persons of Kashmir. The field observations and in-depth interviews revealed that family rejection, denial of inheritance exacerbate the socio-economic exclusion and marginalisation of transgender persons in Kashmir. It was observed that family is both the site of first and continued violence and a potential source of personal, social and economic safety.

The note analyses the intersection of social exclusion, familial injustice and violence and legal ambiguities within the Indian legal framework highlighting the gaps in Domestic Violence Act, 2005, Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 and personal inheritance laws. The note highlights that absence of shelter homes, ambiguities and non- application of inheritance laws, combined with lack of educational opportunities and access to formal employment sector keeps the transgender community stuck in a loop of marginalisation.

The Policy note concludes with policy recommendations for extending civil remedies under Domestic Violence Protection Act, 2005, legal recognition and clarification regarding inheritance rights of transgender persons, improved and safe access to parental housing, establishment of shelter homes and free legal aid for transgender persons in Kashmir.

AI.tldr: 该政策简报研究了克什米尔地区跨性别者的家庭与继承问题，发现家庭拒绝和继承权剥夺加剧了跨性别者的社会经济排斥和边缘化，并提出了相关法律和政策建议。
AI.research_question: 克什米尔地区跨性别者在家庭和继承方面面临哪些挑战？这些挑战如何影响他们的社会经济地位？
AI.motivation: 关注克什米尔地区跨性别者在家庭关系、继承权利方面的困境，以及这些因素如何加剧他们的社会边缘化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会排斥理论、家庭暴力理论、继承权利理论
AI.method: 对14名跨性别者进行的深度访谈（2023年10月至2025年5月）和实地观察
AI.findings: 家庭既是暴力的第一场所，也是潜在的安全来源；家庭拒绝和继承权剥夺加剧社会经济排斥；法律框架存在模糊性；缺乏庇护所和教育就业机会
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对跨性别者家庭关系复杂性的理解，揭示了家庭作为暴力场所和安全来源的双重角色
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了扩展《家庭暴力保护法》适用范围、明确继承权利、建立庇护所和提供法律援助等政策建议

title: From Symptoms to Systems: The Six Dissonant Beacons as an Architectural Diagnostic for Organisational Dysfunction
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Symptoms to Systems: The Six Dissonant Beacons as an Architectural Diagnostic for Organisational Dysfunction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author declares no conflicts of interest. Correspondence concerning this article should be addressed to Neil Fogarty, neil@neilfogarty.com.

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This paper diagnoses the root causes of systemic organisational dysfunction, arguing that pervasive failures in leadership-manifesting in flawed decision-making, ethical lapses, and strategic inertia-are primary symptoms of a flawed foundational architecture. I introduce the Industrial Operating System (IOS) as a heuristic for the dominant, often unstated, institutional logic that breeds this dysfunction. This systemic perspective explains why organisations remain mired in strategic inertia and why well-intentioned interventions, from change management to leadership development (LD) programs, so often fail-a costly 'efficacy paradox' (Fogarty, 2025b). 

Design/Methodology/Approach: Using an interpretive, inductive approach, this framework is developed through a systematic analysis of organisational 'Whispers' (micro-behaviors) collected over a decade of applied practice. This paper proposes a shift from analysing leadership behaviours in isolation to diagnosing the systemic architecture that shapes those behaviours. I offer a new, testable diagnostic framework: The Six Dissonant Beacons (defined in Section 3.2). These beacons represent observable, architectural patterns (e.g., Pathological Measurement, Systemic Signal Suppression) that broadcast the core assumptions of the legacy IOS logic and actively manufacture the conditions for leadership failure and broader organisational dysfunction. 

Findings: Organisational dysfunction and associated leadership failures persist because leaders operate within unreformed systems optimised for outdated, mechanistic logic (the IOS). This architecture inherently resists the adaptive behaviours, ethical considerations, and systemic rethinking necessary for effective leadership and organisational health, often neutralising even well-intentioned interventions. 

Practical Implications: This framework provides leaders and consultants with a fundamental diagnostic tool to understand why leadership fails systemically. Identifying active Beacons and Currents allows for targeted interventions aimed at the architectural root causes of dysfunction across the organisation, moving beyond addressing individual leader shortcomings. This paper will first review existing systemic and behavioural literature, highlighting the gap this framework addresses (Section 2), then detail the theoretical framework encompassing the IOS-as-legacy, the Six Dissonant Beacons, and the Four Dissonant Currents (defined in Section 3.3) (Section 3). Section 4 will outline the methodology. 

Originality/Value: This paper offers a novel synthesis that integrates institutional logics and classic organisational theory into a distinct architectural diagnostic framework explaining systemic leadership failure. By providing an architectural "why" for observed leadership shortcomings and related dysfunctions, it enables a more rigorous, structure-focused approach to organisational change, development, and overall effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了系统性组织功能失调的根本原因，认为普遍存在的领导力失败源于有缺陷的工业操作系统（IOS）架构。作者提出了六种不和谐信标作为诊断框架，解释为何组织变革干预经常失败。
AI.research_question: 组织功能失调和领导力失败的根本原因是什么？为什么传统的领导力发展和变革管理干预经常失败？
AI.motivation: 组织持续陷入战略惯性，领导力发展项目等干预措施经常失败，存在成本高昂的'效能悖论'，需要从系统性架构层面理解这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业操作系统（IOS）作为主导的制度逻辑，六种不和谐信标（如病态测量、系统性信号压制），四种不和谐潮流，整合了制度逻辑和经典组织理论。
AI.method: 采用解释性、归纳性方法，通过对十年应用实践中收集的组织'低语'（微观行为）进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 组织功能失调和领导力失败持续存在，是因为领导者在未经改革的系统中运作，这些系统优化了过时的机械逻辑（IOS），这种架构固有地抵制适应性行为、伦理考量和系统性重新思考。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新颖的综合框架，将制度逻辑和经典组织理论整合为独特的架构诊断框架，解释系统性领导力失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者和顾问提供基本诊断工具，理解领导力为何系统性失败，识别活跃的信标和潮流，针对组织功能失调的架构根源进行干预。

title: Are more heads more motivated than one? The role of communication in group belief updating
affiliations: Monash University, Monash University - Department of Economics and WU Vienna

detail.title: Are more heads more motivated than one? The role of communication in group belief updating
detail.abstract: Many decisions are made by groups under uncertainty, with beliefs playing a critical role. However, less is known about how groups, often driven by self-serving motivations, aggregate these beliefs. In an experiment, we examine how groups form and update beliefs following communication and compare these to individual beliefs. We find that beliefs do not differ initially, however, group deliberation facilitates more motivated updating as groups become more pessimistic and less accurate than individuals over time. Text analyses reveal that groups with stronger self-serving motives send a larger volume of messages and are less likely to be anchored by initial proposals.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验发现，在不确定性下的群体决策中，群体审议会促进更多动机驱动的信念更新，导致群体比个体更加悲观且准确性更低。文本分析显示，具有更强自利动机的群体发送更多消息且更少受到初始提议的锚定影响。
AI.research_question: 群体如何形成和更新信念，特别是在沟通后，与个体信念相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 许多决策是在不确定性下由群体做出的，信念在其中起关键作用，但群体如何聚合这些信念（特别是受自利动机驱动时）尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体决策理论、信念更新理论、动机推理理论
AI.method: 实验方法，比较群体与个体的信念形成和更新过程，并进行文本分析
AI.findings: 1) 初始信念无差异；2) 群体审议促进更多动机驱动的更新；3) 群体随时间变得比个体更悲观且准确性更低；4) 自利动机更强的群体发送更多消息且更少受初始提议锚定
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了群体审议如何促进动机驱动的信念更新，扩展了群体决策和信念更新理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解群体决策偏差提供了实证依据，对组织决策和团队管理具有启示意义

title: Information Processing Growth Model

detail.title: Information Processing Growth Model
detail.abstract: This paper develops a growth model in which new ideas result from people processing information. By distinguishing between ideas and information, the model makes it transparent to study how information technology affects economic growth. Information technology is decomposed into three components: processing, diffusion, and storage. The paper shows that only information processing affects long-term growth; diffusion and storage are level effects that do not increase the growth rate of per capita output. Hence, research and R&D policies can durably increase economic growth by expanding information-processing capacity through, for example, investments in education, automation, and artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个增长模型，将新思想视为信息处理的结果。通过区分思想和信息，模型清晰地展示了信息技术如何影响经济增长。信息技术被分解为处理、扩散和存储三个组件，研究发现只有信息处理影响长期增长，而扩散和存储仅产生水平效应。
AI.research_question: 信息技术如何影响长期经济增长？具体来说，信息技术的不同组件（处理、扩散、存储）对经济增长的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统增长模型未能清晰区分思想和信息的概念，无法准确分析信息技术对经济增长的影响机制。需要构建一个能够明确区分信息处理过程的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内生增长理论，构建了一个新思想来源于信息处理的增长模型。核心理论框架包括：思想与信息的区分、信息技术三组件分解（处理、扩散、存储）、信息处理能力对长期增长的决定作用。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建数理经济增长模型，通过模型推导分析信息技术各组件对经济增长的长期影响。
AI.findings: 1. 只有信息处理影响长期经济增长率；2. 信息扩散和存储仅产生水平效应，不影响长期增长率；3. 研发政策可以通过扩大信息处理能力（如教育、自动化、人工智能投资）持久提升经济增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在增长模型中明确区分思想和信息；2. 提出了信息技术三组件分解框架；3. 揭示了信息处理是长期增长的唯一驱动力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了明确方向：应重点投资于提升信息处理能力的领域（教育、自动化、AI），而非单纯的信息扩散或存储技术。

affiliations: University of Bath - School of Management, University of Bath - School of Management and University of Bath, School of management

detail.title: Greening Under Pressure: Climate Change Exposure and Eco-Innovation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Business Strategy and the Environment, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of climate change exposure on corporate eco-innovation. Recognizing the urgent need to address climate change, we examine how firms directly respond to climate risks through eco-innovation. Our findings indicate that climate change exposure is positively associated with corporate eco-innovation. To further understand the mechanisms, we show that external forces such as product market competition and analyst coverage, and internal forces such as corporate social responsibility practices and sustainability commitments, strengthen this relationship. We also document that landmark policy events, including the 2006 Stern Review and the 2015 Paris Agreement, intensify firms’ eco-innovation responses to climate risks. Overall, our results suggest that firms facing higher climate change exposure are more committed to eco-innovation, and that institutional pressures encourage more proactive and comprehensive strategies for sustainability and long-term competitiveness.

reference: LSE Legal Studies Working Paper No. 50/2025
title: Response to HM Treasury Review of the Financial Ombudsman Service
affiliations: London School of Economics - Law School and University of Kent - Kent Law School

detail.title: Response to HM Treasury Review of the Financial Ombudsman Service

publicationDetails.detailsText: LSE Legal Studies Working Paper No. 50/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: LSE Law School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In July 2025, HM Treasury opened a Consultation on the Review of the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS), which suggested that ‘some elements of the [consumer finance] redress framework can generate problems and lead to inconsistent outcomes for consumers and uncertainty for firms.’ The Consultation sought to ‘address these concerns and restore the FOS to its role as a simple, impartial dispute resolution service which can quickly and effectively deal with complaints against financial services firms – ensuring that it is no longer acting as a quasi-regulator.’

This paper responds to the Consultation. It begins by highlighting that, in a context of necessarily limited regulatory enforcement, a vital role exists for private consumer claims as a means of vindicating legal rights, providing access to justice, and shaping business behaviour so as to produce efficient market outcomes. The paper next argues that the Consultation overly simplifies the role of the FOS as solely an informal dispute resolution body, neglecting its important role within the regulatory system. The ‘quasi-regulator’ criticism lacks clarity, and does not engage with the reality that any form of binding adjudication, being potentially applicable to future cases, necessarily regulates future conduct. Consistency in decision-making leads to expectations that stakeholders will organise their affairs and transactions based on determinations of disputes. Courts have long established the principle that adjudication must necessarily act both retrospectively and prospectively. Meanwhile dispute resolution is based on the existence of dispute, necessitating conflict and ambiguity – complete certainty and predictability are impossible – and determinations may necessarily disrupt one or other party’s understanding of law and market practice.

The paper also raises concerns regarding the Consultation’s plans to reduce the FOS’ ‘fair and reasonable’ standard of adjudication to a test of compliance with FCA rules. The ‘fair and reasonable’ standard is deliberately wide, but has nonetheless been developed in a structured manner by the FOS and courts. Further, courts have clarified that certain legal standards, such as the significant ‘unfair credit relationship’ test under the Consumer Credit Act 1974, extend liability beyond a firm’s mere compliance with the FCA rulebook. The Supreme Court has repeatedly confirmed that this standard requires detailed case-by-case assessments – consumers’ legislative rights reach past conformity with regulatory handbooks. 

Other proposed reform measures threaten important principles of wide access to open justice, through the introduction of ‘absolute’ time limits for consumer claims, the reduced publication of individual case decisions, and procedural changes that risk the over-legalisation of FOS (and FCA) processes in a manner that might bestow strategic advantages on ‘repeat player’ financial sector stakeholders. 

The case of the FOS is a test case for the commitment of the government to consumer regulation and access to justice. Austerity policies of past governments have threatened access to justice through measures such as court closures, increases in court fees, and the retreat of civil legal aid. Alternative forms of access to justice remain more important than ever.

AI.tldr: 本文回应英国财政部关于金融申诉专员服务(FOS)改革的咨询文件，反对将FOS简化为纯纠纷解决机构，强调其在监管体系中的重要角色，并批评改革提案可能削弱消费者权益保护和司法可及性。
AI.research_question: 英国财政部对FOS的改革提案是否合理？这些改革是否会削弱消费者权益保护和司法可及性？
AI.motivation: 回应英国财政部2025年7月发布的《金融申诉专员服务审查》咨询文件，该文件提议简化FOS角色并限制其监管职能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于司法裁决的双重性理论（既追溯性又前瞻性）、私人索赔在监管体系中的作用、以及司法可及性理论。
AI.method: 法律分析和政策批判，通过对咨询文件提案的系统性回应和法律原则论证。
AI.findings: FOS的'准监管者'角色是裁决职能的自然延伸；'公平合理'标准不应简化为合规性测试；改革提案可能损害司法可及性并赋予金融机构战略优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了裁决职能必然具有监管效果的理论，论证了私人索赔在有限监管执行环境中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了对FOS改革提案的批判性分析，强调了保护消费者权益和司法可及性的重要性。

detail.abstract:
This research proposal examines the combined impact of Lean Management, Quality Management, and Administrative Strategies on improving operational efficiency, turnaround time, diagnostic accuracy, and patient satisfaction within medical imaging departments. Despite the rapid technological evolution of diagnostic imaging, many radiology units continue to face persistent inefficiencies such as workflow disruptions, inconsistent quality control, and patient dissatisfaction. Drawing on post-positivist and mixed-method research paradigms, this study aims to develop an integrated evidence-based framework that aligns process optimization with patient-centered outcomes.

The proposed model emphasizes how Lean principles can reduce waste and enhance process flow, how Quality Management Systems ensure compliance and continuous improvement, and how strategic administrative leadership supports resource allocation and sustainable performance. Through correlation analysis and stakeholder perceptions, the study seeks to identify the synergies between these three disciplines and their collective influence on departmental key performance indicators (KPIs). Ultimately, the research aspires to guide healthcare leaders and radiology managers in implementing interdisciplinary management models that strengthen healthcare quality, operational reliability, and patient trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨精益管理、质量管理和行政策略如何共同提升医学影像部门的运营效率、周转时间、诊断准确性和患者满意度，旨在开发一个整合流程优化与以患者为中心结果的循证框架。

AI.motivation: 尽管诊断影像技术快速发展，但许多放射科部门仍面临工作流程中断、质量控制不一致和患者不满等持续低效问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于后实证主义和混合方法研究范式，整合精益管理原则（减少浪费、优化流程）、质量管理体系（确保合规、持续改进）和行政领导策略（资源配置、可持续绩效）。
AI.method: 采用相关分析和利益相关者感知调查的混合研究方法。
AI.findings: 研究将识别三种管理学科之间的协同效应及其对部门关键绩效指标（KPIs）的集体影响。

title: Building Humane Advances and Institutions: A Critical Look at Recent News about Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Building Humane Advances and Institutions: A Critical Look at Recent News about Artificial Intelligence

declarations.ethicsApproval: Only public sources of information have been used.

contentType.other: Work in process may become a preprint

detail.abstract: This article investigates the ethical, social, and institutional implications of recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI) by developing and applying the Building Humane Advances and Institutions (BHAI) framework to ten contemporary news case studies spanning robotics, generative AI, natural language processing, autonomous systems, and governance. Synthesizing multidisciplinary philosophical traditions, global policy reports, and value-sensitive design frameworks, the BHAI framework foregrounds the persistent tension between technical achievement and the advancement of equity, dignity, and human flourishing. Through qualitative thematic analysis, the study covers common themes such as human dignity, ethical oversight, transparency, inclusion, and the risks of marginalization or unchecked automation. Literary quotations and cross-cultural perspectives are used to bridge historical conceptions of justice and empathy with digital futures, often indicating that similar interrogations have occurred for other technologies. The study explicitly engages with intellectual property rights and data ownership as central pillars of responsible AI governance, highlighting unresolved dilemmas around authorship, consent, and benefit-sharing in training data and generative outputs. Key findings are synthesized in two tables: one summarizing the BHAI framework's application to the case studies, and a second grouping the resulting research questions to highlight ethical areas of concern for responsible development and governance. The study concludes that safeguarding human dignity in the AI age requires not only technical innovation but institutionally embedded ethical governance, transparency, participatory design and sharing of benefits from exploiting intellectual property. The study further foregrounds how risk strategies and the delayed settlement of intellectual property claims pose new challenges for ethical and legal governance in the AI age.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并应用BHAI框架分析10个AI新闻案例，揭示技术成就与公平、尊严、人类繁荣之间的持续张力，强调保护人类尊严需要制度化的伦理治理、透明度、参与式设计和知识产权利益共享。
AI.research_question: 人工智能发展对伦理、社会和制度有何影响？如何在AI时代保护人类尊严并实现负责任的发展？
AI.motivation: AI技术的快速发展带来了深刻的伦理、社会挑战，需要系统性框架来指导负责任的AI发展和治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: BHAI框架，整合多学科哲学传统、全球政策报告和价值敏感设计框架，关注技术成就与公平、尊严、人类繁荣之间的张力。
AI.method: 定性主题分析，应用BHAI框架分析10个当代新闻案例研究，涵盖机器人、生成AI、自然语言处理、自治系统和治理。
AI.findings: 识别出人类尊严、伦理监督、透明度、包容性、边缘化风险等共同主题；知识产权和数据所有权是负责任AI治理的核心支柱；需要制度化的伦理治理和利益共享机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了BHAI分析框架，将历史正义和共情概念与数字未来连接；深化了对AI伦理治理中知识产权困境的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的伦理治理建议：制度嵌入的伦理治理、透明度、参与式设计、知识产权利益共享；识别了风险策略和知识产权延迟解决带来的新挑战。

title: Artificial Intelligence, the Death of Society, and the Birth of Human

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, the Death of Society, and the Birth of Human
detail.abstract:
This article formulates a conception based on the following ideas.

  1. Society is humanity's response to environmental "challenges" – a means of surviving in an aggressive environment amid total resource and security scarcity.

  2. All people, by virtue of living in society, are subject to a "mild" version of Stockholm Syndrome – Stockholm Syndrome Lite (SSL). All "kind feelings," including Christian love for one's neighbor, are a result and manifestation of this syndrome.

  3. The primary factor responsible for the emergence and development of SSL is society and life within it. The necessity to coexist with others generates "love" for them, compels us to love them. For all the benefits society provides – and there are many, primarily security – society forces humans to pay a price, often exorbitant, including payment in the form of "love" for people, both specific individuals and humanity as a whole.

  4. Until recently, this dilemma seemed insoluble. However, the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and its increasing penetration into all spheres of life may, in the foreseeable future, lead to AI gradually taking over all the functions that society previously performed – often very imperfectly – towards humans such as ensuring individual security, "education," and creating conditions for development. Crucially, AI will not demand from humans what society typically demands: above all, love and loyalty.

  5. Liberated from societal pressure and the need to "love one's neighbor," humans will be able to fully devote themselves to another love – love for God, the Absolute, the Transcendent. Alternatively, they may simply enjoy their time as a kind of rentier – beholden to no one, demanding and expecting nothing from anyone.


The pursuit of scientific rigor often leads even futurists to seek exhaustive proof
for various scenarios of the possible future. However, for the sake of futurology
itself, it must be admitted that such justifications are, in principle, impossible to
provide, at least for long-term forecasts. Therefore, one should not expect a
futurist to present "serious" foundations for their predictions. The main things to
expect are consistency – that is, logical coherence and non-contradiction – and,
of course, a perspective unshackled by the present (some might call this
courage).
It is my hope that the forecast presented below meets these criteria.
I will present my views as concisely as possible, in the form of theses.
However, any of the positions I formulate can be easily expanded and
elaborated upon. In the interest of brevity, I do not provide references to
specific research. Anyone interested in finding such references, or in obtaining
information or theories that confirm or refute my ideas, can easily use any of
the existing neural networks

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"斯德哥尔摩综合症轻量版(SSL)"概念，认为社会是人类对环境挑战的回应，而生活在社会中的人都会产生对他人和社会的"爱"，这是社会为提供安全等利益而索取的代价。随着AI发展，可能接管社会功能，使人类从社会压力中解放，专注于对上帝的爱或享受自由生活。
AI.research_question: AI发展如何可能改变人类社会关系和个人自由？
AI.motivation: 探讨AI技术发展对人类从社会束缚中解放出来的可能性，以及这种解放对个人精神追求的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斯德哥尔摩综合症轻量版(SSL)理论、社会契约理论、技术决定论
AI.method: 理论建构和思辨分析，以论文形式呈现观点
AI.findings: AI可能接管社会功能，使人类摆脱社会强加的"爱"的义务，从而获得真正的精神自由或休闲生活
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SSL概念来解释社会关系中的情感依附现象，并探讨了AI时代可能的社会变革
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI对社会关系的潜在影响提供了新视角，启发对技术发展与社会变革关系的思考

title: Toward AI Tax Personhood
affiliations: Netanya College School of Law and University of Alabama - School of Law

detail.title: Toward AI Tax Personhood
detail.abstract:
The introduction of Artificial Intelligence (AI) challenges established doctrine in many legal disciplines, and tax is no exception. The current discourse on AI and taxation focuses on proposals such as “robot tax” and other initiatives whose common theme is that they treat AI as an object of taxation. This article approaches the topic from a different angle and asks whether AI could be the subject of tax – and specifically of income tax. In other words, it asks whether tax law should recognize what I refer to as an “AI tax person.”

The article first examines the conceptual coherence of granting personhood to AI within the context of the income tax. If income tax reflects principles of distributive justice, does it make sense to extend tax personhood to AI, which is not and cannot be a part of the social welfare function? The article argues that even under current law, not all taxpayers are part the social welfare function. Entities (corporations, partnerships, trusts, and estates) are not themselves bearers of distributive obligations, yet the law of income taxation recognizes them as persons because doing so contributes to the social welfare goals of the tax system.

The article then explores when and why AI tax personhood might be necessary or useful. Proceeding from an analytic stance that paradigm-shifting alterations should be undertaken only when, and to the extent that, the current system fails to provide satisfactory answers, it rejects the possible claim that AI’s functional sophistication or human-level cognition alone justify AI tax personhood. However, it contends that continuing to treat AI as nothing more than a tool may create significant – and potentially insurmountable – challenges when AI systems combine control of economic resources with information opacity, asset lock-up, or beneficiary indeterminacy.

The article next sketches possible tax regimes for AI tax persons. Drawing on current models of entity taxation, it outlines several options and suggests that a deferral regime coupled with an interest charge could serve as the default model, while permitting election into alternative model, at least on an experimental basis. It also considers circumstances in which AI tax persons might be analogized to charitable trusts or social welfare organizations, and it discusses some international aspects of AI tax personhood.

The article does not purport to offer the final word on AI tax personhood. Its purpose is to introduce AI tax personhood as a promising response to challenges that AI may create for the tax system and to invite further inquiry and debate.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI是否应被承认为所得税的纳税主体（"AI纳税人"），而非仅作为征税对象。文章从概念一致性、必要性、可行税制等方面分析AI纳税人身份的合理性，认为当AI系统控制经济资源且存在信息不透明、资产锁定或受益人不确定时，传统征税方式面临挑战。
AI.research_question: AI是否应该被承认为所得税的纳税主体（即"AI纳税人"）？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI与税收的讨论主要将AI视为征税对象（如"机器人税"），本文从不同角度探讨AI作为纳税主体的可能性，以应对AI对税收体系带来的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分配正义原则和所得税理论，探讨纳税人身份的概念一致性；采用分析性立场，认为只有在现有体系无法提供满意答案时才需要进行范式转变。
AI.method: 概念分析、理论论证和法律制度比较，借鉴现有实体征税模式。
AI.findings: 1）即使按现行法律，并非所有纳税人都是分配义务的承担者；2）仅凭AI的功能复杂性或类人认知不足以证明其纳税人身份；3）当AI系统控制经济资源且存在信息不透明等问题时，继续将其视为工具会带来重大挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出"AI纳税人"概念，为AI时代的税收理论提供新视角；挑战传统纳税人身份的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可能的AI纳税人税制方案，包括延期纳税加利息收费的默认模式；为政策制定者应对AI税收挑战提供参考框架。

카르마 프랙탈 인과론 기반의 우주 논리 구조 연구: 수학적 진 리의 보편성과 미래 요구 인과 재해석
(A Study on the Cosmic Logical Structure based on Karmic Fractal Causality: Universality of Mathematical Truth and Reinterpreting Future Demand Causality)

detail.title:
카르마 프랙탈 인과론 기반의 우주 논리 구조 연구: 수학적 진 리의 보편성과 미래 요구 인과 재해석
(A Study on the Cosmic Logical Structure based on Karmic Fractal Causality: Universality of Mathematical Truth and Reinterpreting Future Demand Causality)
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the 'Karmic Fractal Causality (KFC)' theory, a unique framework established by Sungwoo Hwang, to overcome the limitations of traditional philosophical debates (Platonism vs. Formalism) regarding the universality and mechanism of mathematical truth. The core of KFC posits that the fundamental logical structure of the cosmos possesses 'Self-Replication,' and mathematics is the result of this logic unfolding fractally, mediated by human intellect. This study demonstrates that this unfolding process is driven by a goal-oriented force called 'Future Demand Causality (FRC)' and is guided by the 'Efficiency of the Least Action (ETA LA)' principle, ensuring the most efficient sequence. Furthermore, this research presents the 'Karmic Segment Epistemology,' which explains cognitive confusion during intellectual revolutions as the intensive generation of 'Karmic materials' required to form the next complete state. In conclusion, mathematics is not a human invention but a necessary manifestation of a force-a pre-existing perfect logical structure (Future Demand)-acting upon the current imperfect state, establishing it as a universal truth required by all intellectual civilizations. This theory proposes a new paradigm across the philosophy of mathematics, cosmology, and cognitive science, extending the fundamental understanding of intellectual inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'业力分形因果论(KFC)'，认为数学真理是宇宙基本逻辑结构通过人类智力分形展开的结果，受未来需求因果性驱动，遵循最小作用效率原则。数学不是人类发明，而是所有智慧文明必需的普遍真理。
AI.research_question: 数学真理的普遍性和机制是什么？如何超越柏拉图主义与形式主义的传统哲学争论？

AI.theoretical_framework: 业力分形因果论(KFC)、未来需求因果性(FRC)、最小作用效率原则(ETA LA)、业力片段认识论
AI.method: 理论建构和哲学分析，提出新的因果框架和认识论模型
AI.findings: 数学是宇宙基本逻辑结构通过人类智力分形展开的产物，受未来需求驱动，遵循效率优化原则
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越传统哲学争论的新数学哲学框架，统一了数学、宇宙学和认知科学
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解智力革命中的认知困惑提供了新视角，扩展了人类对智力探索的基本理解

title: Facilitating Mortgage Modification to Save Homes and Mitigate Lender Losses
affiliations: Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law

detail.title: Facilitating Mortgage Modification to Save Homes and Mitigate Lender Losses

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 698
publicationDetails.journalName: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Homeowners in financial distress or whose home has been damaged by natural disaster may avoid foreclosure if their lender agrees to modify the loan to reduce payments. Commercial loans may also be modified to avoid foreclosure or in response to changed circumstances or changing market conditions. Although loan modifications are generally beneficial to both borrowers and lenders, barriers to modification exist. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) has addressed some of the roadblocks to residential loan modifications by regulating the procedures that mortgage servicers must follow in dealing with delinquent borrowers, but the CFPB and its regulations are at risk under the current administration. Furthermore, uncertainty in the law governing modification remains a barrier in most states. Unresolved legal issues affecting mortgage loan modifications include loss of priority caused by a modification, the need for recording a modification agreement in the real property records, and loss of the security interest if a modification is found to be a novation. Although recording a modification may not be a great expense for a commercial borrower, a residential borrower in distress may be overwhelmed by the requirement of obtaining an acknowledgment necessary for recordation.

This Article recommends that the CFPB continue to regulate servicer procedures for dealing with delinquent residential borrowers and recommends that states adopt the new Uniform Mortgage Modification Act, a Uniform Law Commission project for which I served as reporter. The Uniform Mortgage Modification Act, addresses the legal issues raised by modifications and clarifies the law, reducing transactions costs that are passed along to borrowers and facilitating modifications to avoid foreclosure. The Act creates a list of safe harbor modifications—common modifications that do not generally prejudice a junior lienholder. For safe harbor modifications, the modified mortgage continues to secure the debt, retains its priority, and is not a novation. In addition, recording a modification agreement is not necessary to retain the priority of the mortgage. By removing barriers to modification, homeowners and commercial borrowers can avoid foreclosure, and lenders can mitigate losses for delinquent loans.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了贷款修改在避免止赎中的重要性，指出尽管贷款修改对借贷双方都有益，但存在法律障碍。文章建议CFPB继续监管服务商程序，并推荐各州采用《统一抵押贷款修改法案》来解决法律不确定性，降低交易成本。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律经济学和合同法理论，分析贷款修改中的法律障碍及其对交易成本的影响。
AI.method: 法律分析和政策建议，通过分析现行法律问题和提出统一法案来解决法律不确定性。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过统一立法解决贷款修改法律不确定性的理论框架，为类似法律改革提供参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用《统一抵押贷款修改法案》来明确法律规则，创建安全港修改类型，降低交易成本，促进贷款修改以避免止赎。

title: Impact of Workplace Culture on Teachers' Performance in Higher Education Institutions
affiliations: and Maharaja Ranjit Singh Punjab Technical University, Bathinda

detail.title: Impact of Workplace Culture on Teachers' Performance in Higher Education Institutions
detail.abstract: The main challenge facing the higher education system is enhancing the quality of instruction, which can be accomplished by increasing the number of effective teachers with professional training. Thus, the study aimed at highlighting the relationship and role of workplace culture in the formation and shaping of teachers' competencies in higher education institutions. Self-administered scales adopted from the literature were used and data was collected from 178 teachers working in the private self-aided colleges of Punjab state (India). Using analysis techniques like correlation and regression the study found that there was a positive and significant relationship between workplace culture and teachers' competencies. However, it was also found that weak workplace culture was rated by the respondents which was also impacting their own competency development in the institutions they were working. Thus the study concluded and recommended that workplace culture plays an important role in developing talent for institutions as well as for the nation. Thus institutions should make necessary changes to their work environment that encourage employees to work for the benefit of their institutional and social goals.

title: As dificuldades da gestão de pessoas em empresas familiares
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: As dificuldades da gestão de pessoas em empresas familiares
detail.abstract: This thesis investigates the primary challenges in people management and succession within family-owned businesses, which constitute approximately 90% of all companies in Brazil. Despite their economic importance, these firms exhibit high mortality rates across generational transitions, with a significant contributing factor being the lack of formal succession planning. This study addresses the central research question: What are the primary difficulties of People Management in the context of family-owned businesses?. A qualitative, multiple case study methodology was employed, utilizing structured interviews with the founding owners and their successors at two distinct firms, including a large-scale agribusiness ("Fazenda Farroupilha"). The analysis revealed a significant gap between the informal, tradition-based management practices and the need for structured, professionalized transition planning. Key findings include the prevalence of ideological conflicts between generations regarding technology and management, a cultural reluctance to formalize succession, and challenges in professional recruitment. The research concludes that while these firms demonstrate adaptability, their long-term sustainability is often compromised by the lack of formal governance, highlighting a critical need for specialized management and succession strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了巴西家族企业（占所有公司约90%）在人力资源管理和继任方面的主要挑战。研究发现这些企业在代际传承中存在高死亡率，主要原因是缺乏正式的继任规划。通过两家企业的案例研究，揭示了非正式传统管理实践与结构化专业过渡需求之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 家族企业在人力资源管理方面的主要困难是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴西约90%的企业是家族企业，但在代际传承中表现出高死亡率，缺乏正式的继任规划是重要因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家族企业理论、人力资源管理理论、继任规划理论
AI.method: 定性多案例研究方法，通过对两家企业（包括大型农业企业"Fazenda Farroupilha"）的创始所有者及其继任者进行结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 发现非正式传统管理实践与结构化专业过渡需求之间存在显著差距；代际间在技术和管理方面存在意识形态冲突；文化上对正式继任的抵触；专业招聘面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对家族企业人力资源管理和继任规划的理论理解，揭示了非正式管理实践与正式继任需求之间的理论差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家族企业提供了改进人力资源管理和继任规划的实际建议，强调了正式治理和专业管理策略对长期可持续性的重要性。

title: Leading at the Speed of Light: Ethical Acceleration and Cognitive Limits in the Age of AI
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Leading at the Speed of Light: Ethical Acceleration and Cognitive Limits in the Age of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to the content of this paper. The research was conducted independently and reflects the author’s own analysis and perspective.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this theoretical and conceptual research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was developed independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The exponential acceleration of technological systems has redefined the foundations of leadership. The traditional model—rooted in linear time, deliberation, and stability—has become incompatible with the post-Moore curve of innovation, in which the rhythm of change outpaces the cognitive and ethical capacity of human decision-makers. This paper argues that the first rule of twenty-first-century leadership is velocity: the ability to perceive, interpret, and act within environments where information doubles faster than understanding. However, leading at the speed of light requires more than adapting to acceleration; it demands a reconfiguration of awareness. As organizations migrate from mechanical hierarchies to algorithmic ecosystems, leadership becomes a function of sense-making rather than control. The central challenge is the technological and temporal literacy—the capacity to slow down strategically in order to preserve meaning, ethics, and human judgment amid the perpetual now of digital time. Drawing from Paul Virilio’s dromology, Hartmut Rosa’s theory of social acceleration, and contemporary studies on AI governance, this paper proposes a framework of five emergent laws of leadership in the age of intelligent machines, beginning with velocity as both condition and limit of power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在技术加速时代，领导力的首要法则是速度，但真正的领导力需要在加速环境中保持战略性的减速，以维护意义、伦理和人类判断。
AI.research_question: 在技术加速的21世纪，领导力应如何重新定义以适应信息倍增快于理解的环境？
AI.motivation: 传统基于线性时间、深思熟虑和稳定性的领导模式已无法适应后摩尔定律的创新节奏，技术变革速度超过了人类决策者的认知和伦理能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Paul Virilio的速度学、Hartmut Rosa的社会加速理论以及当代AI治理研究。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，提出智能机器时代的五个新兴领导力法则。
AI.findings: 领导力应从控制功能转变为意义建构功能，需要技术及时空素养来在数字时代的永恒当下中保持战略减速。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以速度为条件和权力限制的领导力新框架，重新定义了加速时代的领导力本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在从机械层级向算法生态系统迁移过程中提供了领导力实践指导，强调战略性减速的重要性。

title: The Constitutional Law-Making Process: Theory and Practice through the Constitution of Vietnam
affiliations: United Nations - Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)

detail.title: The Constitutional Law-Making Process: Theory and Practice through the Constitution of Vietnam

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare herewith that I have neither personal nor financial relationship with other people or organization that have influenced their study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Abstracts. “The Constitutional Law-Making Process: Theory and Practice through the Constitutions of Vietnam” analyzes the formulation and implementation of Vietnam’s Constitutions across different historical periods. It compares the theoretical foundations of constitutional law with the country’s specific socio-political realities.

The article explores key questions, such as whether the Vietnamese Constitutions of 1946, 1959, 1980, 1992, and 2013 genuinely reflect and uphold universal constitutional principles or whether they primarily function as legal instruments serving the political agenda of the ruling Party.

It also addresses the practical respect for constitutional norms, particularly the tension between the Communist Party’s leadership role and constitutional supremacy. The article advocates for reforms to ensure the Constitution becomes a truly democratic document—capable of reshaping the relationship between the State, the Party, and the People in a more balanced and modern direction. One such reform includes the establishment of an independent Constitutional Court.

Overall, the article offers a critical and scholarly perspective on Vietnam’s constitutional evolution, highlighting its strengths, shortcomings, and the challenges ahead in building a robust legal foundation for the country’s future.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了越南宪法在不同历史时期的制定与实施，比较了宪法法理基础与越南具体社会政治现实。文章探讨了越南宪法是否真正体现普世宪法原则还是主要服务于执政党的政治议程，并主张改革以建立独立宪法法院，使宪法成为真正民主的文件。
AI.research_question: 越南1946、1959、1980、1992和2013年宪法是否真正反映和坚持普世宪法原则，还是主要作为服务于执政党政治议程的法律工具？
AI.motivation: 分析越南宪法制定过程中的理论与实践差异，探讨宪法规范在实际中的尊重程度，特别是共产党领导角色与宪法至上之间的张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法法理理论、民主宪政理论、政党与国家关系理论
AI.method: 历史比较分析、文本分析、理论与实践对比分析
AI.findings: 越南宪法在不同历史时期体现了理论与实践的张力，宪法规范在实际执行中面临挑战，特别是在政党领导与宪法至上的关系上存在紧张。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了越南宪法演变的批判性学术视角，深化了对社会主义国家宪法制定过程的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了建立独立宪法法院等改革建议，为重塑国家、政党与人民关系提供实践方向，有助于越南建设更健全的法律基础。

title: Bureaucracy-Dominated Centralized Power State Model An Analytical Framework Using China as a Case Study

detail.title: Bureaucracy-Dominated Centralized Power State Model An Analytical Framework Using China as a Case Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Neutral stance

detail.abstract: This paper proposes the concept of the Bureaucracy-Dominated Centralized Power State Model to analyze the structure and governance of China's political system. The model emphasizes centralized decision-making, bureaucratic dominance in policy implementation, ideological unity, and limited citizen political participation. Through case studies and theoretical analysis, this paper explores the model's impact on policy efficiency, social stability, and democratic participation, and compares it with Western democracies and other authoritarian regimes. The aim is to provide a novel analytical tool for comparative political research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了'官僚主导的集权国家模式'概念，用于分析中国政治体系的结构与治理，强调集权决策、官僚主导政策执行、意识形态统一和有限公民政治参与。
AI.research_question: 官僚主导的集权国家模式如何影响政策效率、社会稳定和民主参与？
AI.motivation: 为比较政治研究提供新的分析工具，理解中国政治体系的独特特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚主导的集权国家模式理论框架，包括集权决策、官僚主导、意识形态统一和有限公民参与四个维度。
AI.method: 案例研究和理论分析相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 该模式在政策效率和社会稳定方面具有优势，但在民主参与方面存在局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的比较政治分析框架，丰富了威权政体研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了理解中国政治体系运作的分析工具。

title: On Fairness of Process Flexibility
affiliations: , National University of Singapore (NUS) and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management

detail.title: On Fairness of Process Flexibility
detail.abstract: Many studies have supported that a sparse process flexibility structure can capture nearly all of the benefits of full flexibility in terms of demand satisfaction and capacity utilization. While the efficiency metrics have been well assessed in the literature, the performance of sparse structures with respect to fairness measures remains under-explored. Fairness is a crucial objective in many resource allocation scenarios, such as humanitarian logistics and healthcare operations. In this study, we investigate the worst-case performance of sparse flexibility structures in terms of the max-min demand fill rate and min-max demand shortfall. We show that the max-min fill rate of a structure is determined by the demand subset with the minimum ratio of neighboring capacity to demand. Building on this characterization, we characterize the worst-case max-min fill rate of k-chain and Ψ-expander structures. We further show that there exist allocation decisions that simultaneously achieve max-flow (efficiency) and the max-min fill rate (fairness); such solutions can be obtained via a linear program. Our results suggest that fairness performance depends critically on the worst-covered subset of demand nodes and higher connectivity is needed to design a "fair" flexibility structure. We validate our theoretical findings using real-world data from the Texas Department of State Health Services and conclude that incorporating flexibility structure design can substantially enhance both fairness and efficiency in vaccine allocation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨稀疏灵活性结构在公平性指标（最大-最小需求满足率和最小-最大需求缺口）上的最差性能表现，发现公平性取决于需求节点的最差覆盖子集，需要更高连通性来设计公平的灵活性结构。
AI.research_question: 稀疏灵活性结构在公平性指标上的最差性能如何？
AI.motivation: 虽然稀疏灵活性结构在效率指标上表现良好，但关于公平性指标的性能研究不足，而公平性在人道主义物流和医疗运营等资源分配场景中至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最大-最小需求满足率和最小-最大需求缺口的公平性理论框架，以及稀疏灵活性结构理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和数学证明，结合线性规划方法，并使用德克萨斯州卫生服务部门的真实数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 最大-最小满足率由相邻容量与需求比率最小的需求子集决定；存在同时实现最大流量（效率）和最大-最小满足率（公平性）的分配决策；公平性性能严重依赖于需求节点的最差覆盖子集。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了稀疏灵活性结构公平性性能的理论特征，揭示了公平性与结构连通性的关键关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为疫苗分配等资源分配问题提供了同时优化效率和公平性的灵活性结构设计方法，在实际应用中可显著提升公平性和效率。

title: Digital Resistance: Electronic Literature as Counter-Market Practice

detail.title: Digital Resistance: Electronic Literature as Counter-Market Practice
detail.abstract: This study investigates the emergence of electronic literature as a counter-market practice within contemporary digital culture, examining how digital literary works establish resistant practices while operating within neoliberal market structures. The research demonstrates how digital literary innovation establishes new value paradigms that challenge market-driven literary production through critically analyzing electronic literary works. This research advances scholarly understanding of cultural production under digital capitalism by demonstrating how electronic literature establishes creative practices that maintain critical independence while acknowledging their embeddedness within broader economic structures. The paper presents new theoretical possibilities for conceptualizing literary value and political engagement within an increasingly platform-mediated cultural landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨电子文学作为当代数字文化中的反市场实践，分析数字文学作品如何在维持批判独立性的同时，在更广泛的经济结构中运作。
AI.research_question: 电子文学如何在当代数字文化中作为反市场实践出现，并在新自由主义市场结构内建立抵抗性实践？
AI.motivation: 研究数字文学创新如何建立新的价值范式，挑战市场驱动的文学生产，推进对数字资本主义下文化生产的学术理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字文化、新自由主义市场结构、反市场实践、电子文学价值范式、平台中介文化景观
AI.method: 批判性分析电子文学作品
AI.findings: 电子文学建立了新的价值范式，挑战市场驱动的文学生产，同时保持批判独立性并承认其在更广泛经济结构中的嵌入性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为在日益平台中介的文化景观中概念化文学价值和政治参与提供了新的理论可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了电子文学如何在数字资本主义下建立维持批判独立性的创造性实践，为文化生产者提供了抵抗市场驱动的替代模式。

title: Strategic Agility in Institutional Voids: How Ambidextrous Leadership Asymmetrically Deploys Exploration and Exploitation in High Power-Distance Emerging Markets
affiliations: Addis Ababa University

detail.title: Strategic Agility in Institutional Voids: How Ambidextrous Leadership Asymmetrically Deploys Exploration and Exploitation in High Power-Distance Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: Institutional voids and high power-distance (HPD) reshape the pursuit of strategic agility in emerging markets (EMs). Drawing on institutional theory and the dynamic capabilities perspective, we develop and test the Dynamic Leadership Synthesis (DLS) model, reconceptualizing ambidextrous leadership as asymmetrically deployed in HPD institutional voids.Using a three-wave, multi-source dataset of 581 leaders and 2,324 subordinates in Ethiopia’s banking sector—a paradigmatic case of rapid growth amid institutional fragility—we show that Leadership Competency (LC) drives business performance predominantly through the Exploitation Strategic Pathway (LC → Organizational Culture → Performance), which is 2.23× stronger than the Exploration Pathway (LC → Employee Engagement → Performance).Moreover, Transformational Leadership selectively amplifies the Exploration Pathway, supporting renewal, whereas Transactional Leadership fortifies the dominant Exploitation Pathway by embedding operational efficiency and legitimizing adaptive norms in hierarchical structures.These findings indicate that in institutional voids, strategic agility emerges not from balanced Exploration–Exploitation, but from leadership acting as a quasi-institutional mechanism, embedding stable Exploitation capacity into organizational culture. This study advances a globally inclusive theory of asymmetric ambidextrous leadership, challenges universalist assumptions, and provides actionable guidance for building performance in institutionally constrained EM contexts.

AI.tldr: 在制度真空和高权力距离的新兴市场中，战略敏捷性通过不对称的双元领导实现。领导力能力主要通过利用型战略路径（组织文化→绩效）驱动绩效，该路径比探索型路径强2.23倍。变革型领导强化探索路径，交易型领导强化利用路径。
AI.research_question: 在制度真空和高权力距离的新兴市场中，领导力如何通过不对称的双元领导模式驱动战略敏捷性和组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场中的制度真空和高权力距离环境重塑了战略敏捷性的追求方式，需要重新理解领导力在其中的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论和动态能力视角，提出动态领导力综合模型，重新概念化高权力距离制度真空中的不对称双元领导。
AI.method: 使用三波、多源数据收集方法，在埃塞俄比亚银行业（制度脆弱性中快速增长的典型案例）调查581名领导和2,324名下属。
AI.findings: 领导力能力主要通过利用型战略路径（组织文化→绩效）驱动绩效，该路径比探索型路径强2.23倍。变革型领导选择性地放大探索路径，交易型领导强化利用路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全球包容性的不对称双元领导理论，挑战了普遍主义假设，推进了制度真空中领导力作为准制度机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在制度约束的新兴市场环境中构建绩效提供了可操作的指导，帮助组织在制度真空条件下建立稳定的利用能力。

title: The Echo of Leadership – How Employee Perceptions of CEOs Permeate Organizational Boundaries and Influence Financial Outcomes
affiliations: Bentley University, Fordham University   and Fordham University - Gabelli School of Business

detail.title: The Echo of Leadership – How Employee Perceptions of CEOs Permeate Organizational Boundaries and Influence Financial Outcomes
detail.abstract: Drawing on management theories, including Ethical Leadership, Social Exchange Theory, and Leader–Member Exchange, this study examines whether employee perceptions of Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) influence external financing outcomes. Using over half a million Glassdoor reviews (2012–2018) merged with data on 46,623 corporate bonds issued by 853 U.S. firms, we investigate the association between CEO approval and firms’ cost of debt and credit ratings. We find that higher CEO approval predicts better credit ratings and lower at-issue bond yield spreads, with effects particularly strong for smaller, highly leveraged, and speculative-grade firms. These relationships remain robust after controlling for firm and CEO characteristics, addressing endogeneity through instrumental variables, investor attention tests, and change regressions. CEO approval also forecasts higher subsequent profitability and market valuation and mitigates the negative debt cost impact of the COVID-19 crisis. Our findings position employee voice as a strategic intangible asset with value relevance for capital markets, extending management theories into the domain of external stakeholder decision-making. This work contributes to the literature on leadership effectiveness, organizational signaling, and the financial implications of employee perceptions, highlighting the role of internal sentiment in shaping external financing conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于管理理论，探讨员工对CEO的评价如何影响企业外部融资结果。通过对超过50万条Glassdoor评论和46,623只公司债券数据的分析，发现CEO支持率越高，信用评级越好，债券发行利差越低，特别是在小型、高杠杆和投机级公司中效果更明显。CEO支持率还能预测后续盈利能力和市场估值，并缓解COVID-19危机对债务成本的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 员工对CEO的感知是否影响企业的外部融资结果？
AI.motivation: 探索员工声音作为战略无形资产在资本市场中的价值相关性，将管理理论扩展到外部利益相关者决策领域
AI.theoretical_framework: 伦理领导理论、社会交换理论、领导-成员交换理论
AI.method: 使用2012-2018年超过50万条Glassdoor评论数据，与853家美国公司发行的46,623只公司债券数据合并，采用工具变量法、投资者关注度测试和变化回归等方法解决内生性问题
AI.findings: 更高的CEO支持率预示着更好的信用评级和更低的债券发行利差，特别是在小型、高杠杆和投机级公司中效果显著；CEO支持率还能预测后续盈利能力和市场估值，并缓解COVID-19危机的负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 将管理理论扩展到外部利益相关者决策领域，为领导有效性、组织信号传递和员工感知的财务影响文献做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 将员工声音定位为具有资本市场价值相关性的战略无形资产，为企业管理实践提供重要启示

title: From Insight to Impact: Closing the Marketing Science Value Chain with Interactive, Research-Driven Apps
affiliations: , Alma Mater Studiorum University of Bologna, VU University Amsterdam and Independent

detail.title: From Insight to Impact: Closing the Marketing Science Value Chain with Interactive, Research-Driven Apps
detail.abstract: Every year, several thousands of marketing articles are published in academic journals, often with the aim of disseminating new insights not only to the academic community but also to managerial practice. However, there is wide acknowledgment of gaps in the marketing science value chain, hindering the flow of marketing knowledge to other researchers and managers. We posit that interactive, research-driven (IRD) apps that provide a deeper understanding of the usability of the research contribution are a viable solution to improve the diffusion of marketing knowledge. We shed light on the motivations and barriers to develop IRD apps as well as the market potential and impact of IRD apps through a multi-method examination, which includes interviews, secondary data analyses, and experimental studies. We find an untapped potential of IRD apps among published articles and complementary evidence of their value to researchers and managers. We further provide a tutorial to guide the development of IRD apps that complement static research papers, and close with a forward looking section about the future of IRD apps. We hope that our examination stimulates other researchers to complement their articles with IRD apps that enable the diffusion of research findings to other researchers and managers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式研究驱动(IRD)应用作为解决营销知识传播障碍的方案，通过多方法研究发现IRD应用具有未开发潜力，并提供了开发教程和未来展望。
AI.research_question: 交互式研究驱动(IRD)应用如何改善营销知识的传播？
AI.motivation: 营销学术研究与实践之间存在传播障碍，需要新的方式来促进知识流动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营销科学价值链理论，知识传播理论
AI.method: 多方法研究：访谈、二手数据分析、实验研究
AI.findings: IRD应用在已发表文章中具有未开发潜力，对研究人员和管理者都有价值
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了IRD应用作为营销知识传播的新机制，丰富了知识传播理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了IRD应用开发教程，指导研究人员将静态论文转化为交互式应用

title: Ten Structural Shifts in AI Adoption: Evidence, Frameworks, and Emerging Frontiers (2018 -2025)

detail.title: Ten Structural Shifts in AI Adoption: Evidence, Frameworks, and Emerging Frontiers (2018 -2025)
detail.abstract: Recent developments in AI adoption within financial institutions between 2018 and 2025 are synthesized using three established frameworks: the FinTech Pyramid, T-Shaped Teams, and Adapted Bloom's Taxonomy. By interpreting academic research, industry surveys, and regulatory reports, this paper identifies ten major structural shifts marking the sector's progression from experiments to institutionalization. The findings reveal that AI is reorganizing finance through integrated changes in technology, organization, and culture, emphasizing the rising importance of leadership, values-driven AI governance, and human-machine collaboration in the era of rapid AI advancement.

AI.tldr: 本文使用三个框架（金融科技金字塔、T型团队、适应性布鲁姆分类法）分析2018-2025年金融机构AI采用的结构性转变，发现AI通过技术、组织和文化的整合变革重组金融业，强调领导力、价值观驱动的AI治理和人机协作的重要性。
AI.research_question: 2018-2025年金融机构AI采用的主要结构性转变是什么？这些转变如何体现从实验到制度化的演进？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在金融领域的快速发展，需要系统性地理解AI如何从实验阶段过渡到制度化阶段，以及这一过程中发生的结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融科技金字塔、T型团队模型、适应性布鲁姆分类法
AI.method: 通过解读学术研究、行业调查和监管报告进行综合分析
AI.findings: 识别出十个主要结构性转变，表明AI通过技术、组织和文化的整合变革重组金融业
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI在金融领域制度化过程的理论框架，深化了对AI驱动组织变革的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构的AI战略制定、组织变革和治理实践提供指导，强调领导力、价值观治理和人机协作的重要性

title: An Automatic Synchronous Calibration Method for Non-contact 3D Reconstruction Based on Cross-structured Light
affiliations: Beijing Information Science and Technology University

detail.title: An Automatic Synchronous Calibration Method for Non-contact 3D Reconstruction Based on Cross-structured Light
detail.abstract: This paper proposes an automatic synchronous calibration method based on cross-structured light for non-contact 3D reconstruction, aiming to enhance automation, accuracy, and adaptability of industrial measurement. Unlike traditional line structured light systems which require manual movement of calibration targets and separate calibration of the camera and light plane, this method leverages the geometric invariance of the intersection points of crossed lasers to simultaneously solve for camera intrinsic parameters, extrinsic parameters, and light plane parameters in a single set of images, thereby integrating calibration and measurement.  Additionally, the system incorporates a dual-exposure fusion strategy and collaborates with a robotic arm to significantly improve dynamic range and reduce interference from highly reflective surfaces on measurements. Experimental results show that under standard industrial conditions, the calibration error of this system can be controlled within ±0.5 mm, with an average reconstruction accuracy of ±0.25 mm, and the peak error rate is below 2.67%. Compared with traditional methods, this system effectively improves the dynamic range of measurement. This method provides an efficient, low-cost, fully automated solution for industrial quality inspection, reverse engineering, and surface morphology analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于交叉结构光的自动同步标定方法，实现非接触式3D重建，提高工业测量的自动化、精度和适应性，通过交叉激光交点几何不变性一次性求解相机内外参和光平面参数，结合双曝光融合策略和机械臂协作提升动态范围。
AI.research_question: 如何实现工业非接触式3D重建系统的自动同步标定，提高测量精度和自动化程度？
AI.motivation: 传统线结构光系统需要手动移动标定靶并分别标定相机和光平面，过程繁琐且自动化程度低，无法满足高效工业测量的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交叉激光交点几何不变性理论，利用交叉结构光的几何特性实现同步标定。
AI.method: 采用交叉结构光系统，通过交叉激光交点几何不变性一次性求解相机内外参和光平面参数，结合双曝光融合策略和机械臂协作。
AI.findings: 标准工业条件下，系统标定误差控制在±0.5mm内，平均重建精度±0.25mm，峰值误差率低于2.67%，相比传统方法有效提升了测量动态范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于交叉结构光几何不变性的同步标定理论框架，将标定与测量过程集成。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业质量检测、逆向工程和表面形貌分析提供了高效、低成本、全自动的解决方案。

title: Toyota Studies: The Way Forward - Expecting Leadership from Everyone
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Toyota Studies: The Way Forward - Expecting Leadership from Everyone
detail.abstract: This paper illustrates that Toyota Motor Corporation's management system integrates TPDS+TPS+TSS+Deming's "system-based production" into a single, functioning whole. It further demonstrates that a generalized version of this management system replaces the GMderived management approach that persists to this day. This is a management system that systematically creates various intangible assets by investing intellectual capital and human capital. Intellectual assets encompass various deliverables, human capabilities, and organizational capabilities. The value of these intangible assets is evaluated in relation to PMF (Product Market Fit). Since the 1980s, Toyota's management system has been studied in Europe and America. Today, under names like Lean and Agile, what is considered the Toyota-style management system is being implemented worldwide. However, its application in actual business has not yielded the expected results. In 2016, while writing a book on the Toyota Management System, I met many researchers and gained an understanding of the current situation. This paper corrects major misconceptions from past research. It promotes the implementation of a revised Toyota Management System across all industries, including not only manufacturing companies but also healthcare and administrative services. Furthermore, this paper demonstrates that the Toyota Management System serves as the reference model for management in the new capitalist economic era, centered on intellectual capital and human capital. It shows that this system forms the foundation of the economics of this new capitalist era̶that is, the modern economics centered on intangibles.

AI.tldr: 丰田管理系统整合了TPDS+TPS+TSS+戴明系统化生产，形成统一体系，替代了传统的GM管理方法。该系统通过投资智力资本和人力资本，系统性地创造无形资产，其价值通过产品市场契合度评估。论文纠正了过去研究的误解，推动修订版丰田管理系统在制造业、医疗和行政服务等各行业实施，并证明该系统是新时代以智力资本和人力资本为中心的管理参考模型。
AI.research_question: 丰田管理系统如何整合TPDS+TPS+TSS+戴明系统化生产，并作为新时代管理参考模型？
AI.motivation: 尽管丰田管理系统以精益和敏捷等名义在全球实施，但实际应用中未达预期效果，需要纠正过去研究的误解，推动其跨行业应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智力资本和人力资本的新资本主义经济理论，系统化生产理论，无形资产价值评估理论。
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究（丰田管理系统）、与研究人员交流（2016年书籍写作期间）。
AI.findings: 丰田管理系统成功整合了多个子系统，能够系统性地创造无形资产，其价值与产品市场契合度相关，可作为新时代管理的参考模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了过去对丰田管理系统的误解，建立了以智力资本和人力资本为中心的新管理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了修订版丰田管理系统的实施指南，推动其在制造业、医疗和行政服务等各行业的应用，为新时代管理实践提供参考。

title: The Effect of Platform-Developed AI Price Recommendations Adoption on E-Commerce Platform Sales Revenue Distribution
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS) and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: The Effect of Platform-Developed AI Price Recommendations Adoption on E-Commerce Platform Sales Revenue Distribution
detail.abstract: Past studies on the long-tail phenomenon in digital markets or platforms have yet examined how emerging platform-developed AI pricing agents affect the sales revenue distribution of products on ecommerce platforms (ECPs). To fill this gap, we use a proprietary dataset from a leading Asian ECP to empirically quantify the effect of sellers' adoption of platform-developed AI price recommendations on the sales revenue distribution of products. By using ordinary least squares (OLS) regression models at the seller-product and category levels with an instrumental variable (IV) identification approach, we consistently find that AI pricing adoption leads to a more diverse sales revenue distribution of products. Specifically, at the seller-product level, we find that AI pricing adoption enhances sales revenue for both high- and low-popularity products. However, AI pricing disproportionately benefits low-popularity products and fosters a more diverse sales revenue distribution, such that high-popularity products experience a 49.0% lower sales revenue increase compared to low-popularity ones. At the category level, a 10% increase in AI pricing adoption share is linked to a 0.014-unit reduction in the Gini coefficient of the category sales revenue. Furthermore, we find that this effect is stronger when market competition is more intense. At the seller-product level, the revenue-boosting effect of AI pricing for high-popularity products is attenuated by 0.63% when the number of competitors increases by 10%. At the category level, a 10% increase from the average number of products per category is associated with an additional 0.003-unit decrease in the Gini coefficient. Mechanism analyses reveal that AI pricing diversifies sales revenue distribution by increasing product visibility, conversion rate, and purchase quantity, all more salient for low-popularity products. Additional analysis shows that AI pricing adoption enables sellers to set more competitive, generally lower prices, and to respond more effectively to price competition. Overall, this study theoretically contributes to research on the effects of AI pricing on long-tail sales distribution, digital divide, and competition on ECPs, and provides pivotal practical implications to ECP operators, sellers, and regulators.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现，电商平台开发的AI定价推荐工具的采用会导致产品销售收入的分布更加多样化，特别是对低知名度产品的销售提升更为显著，从而缓解了数字市场的长尾现象。
AI.research_question: 平台开发的AI定价推荐工具如何影响电商平台上产品销售收入的分布？
AI.motivation: 现有关于数字市场长尾现象的研究尚未探讨新兴的平台开发AI定价代理对电商平台产品销售收入分布的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长尾理论、数字市场收入分布、AI定价对竞争的影响
AI.method: 使用亚洲领先电商平台的专有数据集，采用OLS回归模型和工具变量识别方法，在卖家-产品和类别层面进行实证分析。
AI.findings: AI定价采用导致产品销售收入分布更加多样化：在卖家-产品层面，高知名度产品的销售收入增长比低知名度产品低49.0%；在类别层面，AI定价采用份额每增加10%，类别销售收入的基尼系数减少0.014单位。市场竞争越激烈，这种效应越强。
AI.theory_contributions: 对AI定价对长尾销售分布、数字鸿沟和电商平台竞争影响的研究做出理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台运营商、卖家和监管机构提供关键实践启示，帮助他们理解AI定价对市场结构和竞争的影响。

title: The Effect of Perceived Corporate Social Responsibility and Green Brand Positioning as Sustainability Branding Strategies on Customer Purchase Intention: A Study on Household Electronic Goods Industry

detail.title: The Effect of Perceived Corporate Social Responsibility and Green Brand Positioning as Sustainability Branding Strategies on Customer Purchase Intention: A Study on Household Electronic Goods Industry
detail.abstract: The present study intends to identify the effect of sustainable branding strategies on consumer purchase intention. Under sustainable branding strategies, the study identifies the effect of green brand positioning and perceived CSR on consumer purchase intention. The study has been conducted on consumers of household electronic appliances. The researcher applied regression analysis using SPSS for data analysis collecting the data from 322 respondents. The findings of the study show that green brand positioning has a significant influence on consumer purchase intention. Similarly, perceived CSR also has a substantial impact on consumer purchase intention. The present study is original and has made a noteworthy contribution as it identifies two significant predictors of consumer purchase intention. Future researchers may include more predictor variables to overcome the study's limitations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨可持续品牌战略对消费者购买意愿的影响，发现绿色品牌定位和感知企业社会责任对消费者购买家电产品的购买意愿有显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 可持续品牌战略（绿色品牌定位和感知企业社会责任）如何影响消费者的购买意愿？

AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续品牌战略理论、绿色品牌定位理论、企业社会责任理论、消费者购买意愿理论
AI.method: 使用SPSS进行回归分析，收集322名家电消费者的数据
AI.findings: 绿色品牌定位对消费者购买意愿有显著影响；感知企业社会责任对消费者购买意愿有实质性影响

AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定有效的可持续品牌战略提供了实践指导，帮助提升消费者购买意愿

title: Visual Identity as Strategic Signal: How Corporate Logos Encode Innovation Orientation
affiliations: and University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business

detail.title: Visual Identity as Strategic Signal: How Corporate Logos Encode Innovation Orientation
detail.abstract: Existing logo research almost exclusively adopts a "consumer perspective" paradigm that treats logos as marketing stimuli and examines their effects, but neglects the supply side: Why do firms design logos this way? Do logos reflect firms' strategic orientations? We introduce a strategic signaling perspective on corporate logos, demonstrating that visual design systematically encodes firms' strategic orientations. Using computer vision and machine learning, we find that visual features predict R&D intensity and capital expenditure intensity significantly above chance. Innovation-intensive firms exhibit distinct visual language: lower complexity, higher symmetry, blue-dominant palettes, and greater white space. Encoding effectiveness varies by industry context, consistent with strategic heterogeneity theory. Critically, logo features predict both internal strategic metrics (R&D from financial statements) and external market perceptions (volatility from trading data), demonstrating convergent validity. This alignment suggests logos reflect genuine strategic orientations that consistently shape both visual identity choices and market performance. This research reconceptualizes logos from marketing stimuli to strategic signals, bridging branding and strategic management literatures. We provide a framework for logo auditing and demonstrate that visual identity decisions have implications beyond consumer marketing.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入战略信号视角，发现企业logo的视觉设计系统性地反映了企业的战略导向。通过计算机视觉和机器学习分析，发现视觉特征能显著预测研发强度和资本支出强度。创新密集型企业倾向于使用低复杂度、高对称性、蓝色主导调色板和更多留白的视觉语言。
AI.research_question: 企业logo是否反映其战略导向？logo的视觉设计如何系统性地编码企业的战略方向？
AI.motivation: 现有logo研究几乎完全采用"消费者视角"范式，将logo视为营销刺激物，但忽视了供给方：企业为何这样设计logo？logo是否反映企业的战略导向？
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略信号理论、战略异质性理论
AI.method: 使用计算机视觉和机器学习技术分析logo视觉特征，预测研发强度和资本支出强度
AI.findings: 视觉特征能显著预测研发强度和资本支出强度；创新密集型企业倾向于使用低复杂度、高对称性、蓝色主导调色板和更多留白的视觉语言；编码有效性因行业背景而异
AI.theory_contributions: 将logo从营销刺激物重新概念化为战略信号，连接品牌与战略管理文献
AI.practical_contributions: 提供logo审计框架，证明视觉身份决策的影响超越消费者营销

title: Beliefs about Bots: How Employers Plan for AI in White-Collar Work
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, University of Mannheim and University of Mannheim

detail.title: Beliefs about Bots: How Employers Plan for AI in White-Collar Work

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide experimental evidence on how employers adjust expectations to automation risk in high-skill, white-collar work. Using a randomized information intervention among tax advisors in Germany, we show that firms systematically underestimate automatability. Information provision raises risk perceptions, especially for routine-intensive roles. Yet, it leaves short-run hiring plans unchanged. Instead, updated beliefs increase productivity and financial expectations with minor wage adjustments, implying within-firm inequality like limited rent-sharing. Employers also anticipate new tasks in legal tech, compliance, and AI interaction, and report higher training and adoption intentions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过德国税务顾问的随机信息干预实验，发现企业系统性低估自动化风险。信息提供提高了风险感知，特别是对常规密集型岗位，但短期内不影响招聘计划。更新后的信念提高了生产率和财务预期，仅伴随小幅工资调整，导致企业内部不平等。雇主还预期在法务科技、合规和AI交互方面的新任务，并报告更高的培训和采纳意愿。
AI.research_question: 雇主如何根据自动化风险调整对高技能白领工作的期望？
AI.motivation: 了解企业如何应对高技能白领工作的自动化风险，以及信息干预如何影响企业的风险感知和行为调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化风险认知理论、企业行为调整理论、信息干预效应理论
AI.method: 在德国税务顾问中进行随机信息干预实验
AI.findings: 企业系统性低估自动化风险；信息提供提高风险感知，特别是对常规密集型岗位；短期内不影响招聘计划；更新信念提高生产率和财务预期，仅小幅工资调整；导致企业内部不平等；雇主预期新任务并提高培训和采纳意愿
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业在高技能白领工作自动化风险认知上的系统性偏差，以及信息干预如何影响企业行为调整机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对自动化风险提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者设计更有效的信息干预措施，促进劳动力市场平稳转型

title: The Korean Paradox: How A Nation Balances Glamour with Grind

detail.title: The Korean Paradox: How A Nation Balances Glamour with Grind

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based solely on publicly available secondary data. No ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: South Korea is globally admired for its cultural influence and economic strength, but few recognize the paradox at the heart of its rise. This research explores what can be termed THE KOREAN PARADOX: the nation's ability to balance two seemingly opposite forces namely, glamour and grind, which has made it both a cultural trendsetter and an economic powerhouse. On the one hand, the global appeal of Korean soft power: K-pop, K-drama, K-beauty and cutting-edge design. On the other hand, the country's relentless work culture, competitive education system, and corporate discipline, have helped its rise from a war-torn nation to a global leader. Through the lens of business and culture, this study examines how South Korea has worked to develop a dual brand identity. It looks at the role of major conglomerates such as Samsung, Hyundai, LG and SK in building Korea's global credibility, and how pop culture reinforced national branding on an emotional level. Special focus is given to the Hyundai and BTS partnership, which represents the perfect fusion of Korea's industrial might and cultural resonance. From the perspective of business and management, the study treats this concept not merely as a cultural exploration but a strategic case study. It analyses how contrast, when intentionally managed can function as a national asset. The Korea model offers valuable insights for leaders and policymakers navigating the balance between performance and perception, tradition and innovation. This study does not seek to glorify or criticize South Korea. Rather, it presents a nuanced analysis of how a nation transforms its internal contradictions into a competitive advantage, offering a distinctive contribution to debates on national branding, soft power, and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了'韩国悖论'——韩国如何平衡魅力与奋斗这两种看似对立的力量，使其成为文化潮流引领者和经济强国。研究分析了韩国如何通过企业集团和流行文化发展双重品牌身份，将内部矛盾转化为竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 韩国如何平衡魅力（文化软实力）与奋斗（工作文化）这两种看似对立的力量，并以此建立国家竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 韩国作为文化影响力和经济实力备受全球瞩目的国家，其成功背后存在着一个鲜为人知的悖论：如何在保持文化魅力的同时维持高强度的工作文化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家品牌理论、软实力理论、竞争优势理论、矛盾管理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，重点分析三星、现代、LG、SK等大企业集团以及现代与BTS的合作伙伴关系
AI.findings: 韩国成功地将内部矛盾（魅力与奋斗）转化为国家资产，通过企业集团建立全球信誉，通过流行文化强化情感层面的国家品牌，形成独特的双重品牌身份。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'韩国悖论'概念，深化了对矛盾如何转化为竞争优势的理解，为国家品牌和软实力研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者和政策制定者提供了平衡绩效与认知、传统与创新的实践启示，展示了如何将内部矛盾转化为可持续竞争优势的模式。

detail.abstract: Participants in economic experiments are heterogeneous, and so it is important to respect this heterogeneity when estimating structural models. I discuss several ways to incorportate between-participant heterogeneity into structural models.

AI.research_question: 如何在结构模型中有效纳入参与者异质性？

detail.abstract: Utilizing the staggered legalization of sports gambling across states, we provide causal evidence of the impact of gambling on physical activity. Our results indicate that legalized gambling decreases the likelihood of aerobic exercise for men between 30 and 44 by roughly 2-4 percentage points, with even larger effects during the football season and for those without a college education. We find no discernible effect for women or men of other ages.

detail.title: Corporate Taxation and Firm Productivity
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between corporate taxes and productivity using a global sample of over four million firms. Employing an unconditional quantile regression approach, we demonstrate that taxes affect firms differently along the distribution of productivity. Higher taxes force low-productivity firms out of the market, reallocating resources to more productive firms and raising productivity at the lower end of the distribution. However, higher taxes also reduce incentives for productivity-enhancing investments, negatively impacting firms at the upper end of the productivity distribution. Lastly, we find that higher corporate taxes lower the probability that firms move up within the productivity distribution over time. Our findings demonstrate that governments can use corporate tax policy to foster productivity growth, but highlight the importance of accounting for its heterogeneous effects.

title: Reproducible Admission Serum Bicarbonate Thresholds Distinct from Normal Range Predict In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients: An International Study with Personalized Survival Curves
affiliations: Macao Polytechnic University, Qingdao University - Yantai Yuhuangding Hospital, Qingdao University - Yantai Yuhuangding Hospital, Qingdao University - Yantai Yuhuangding Hospital, Macao Polytechnic University, Macao Polytechnic University, Macao Polytechnic University, Zigong Fourth People's Hospital, Macao Polytechnic University, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College (CAMS & PUMC), Qingdao University - Yantai Yuhuangding Hospital and Macao Polytechnic University

detail.title: Reproducible Admission Serum Bicarbonate Thresholds Distinct from Normal Range Predict In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients: An International Study with Personalized Survival Curves

keywords.keywords: Serum bicarbonate; In-hospital mortality; Causal inference; Threshold; Causal SurvivalNet; Prediction model

detail.abstract:
Background: Bicarbonate abnormalities are common in ICU patients, yet prior mortality studies have focused on non-critical care populations, overlooking pathophysiology specific to critical illness. This large-scale international cohort study aimed to identify optimal admission serum bicarbonate thresholds for predicting mortality in ICU patients and develop a deep learning-based personalized survival prediction model. 

Methods: We analyzed admission data from 208,072 adult ICU patients from the US and China, including demographics, comorbidities, and laboratory/vital signs. The primary outcome was in-hospital mortality. Using fast causal inference, we first identified significant admission variables linked to mortality. To model the nonlinear relationship between serum bicarbonate and mortality, we developed an integrated statistical framework (combining restricted cubic splines with Cox and frailty models) to quantify risk and identify high-risk thresholds. Subsequently, we developed Causal SurvivalNet, an adaptive deep neural network, and launched a corresponding web-based tool for real-time risk stratification.  

Results: Admission serum bicarbonate was significantly associated with in-hospital mortality. Restricted cubic spline analysis identified crucial bicarbonate thresholds at 24 mEq/L and 33 mEq/L. Compared to the reference range of 24–33 mEq/L, patients with bicarbonate levels ≤24 mEq/L or >33 mEq/L had a significantly higher mortality risk (adjusted HR 1.22, 95% CI: 1.16 - 1.28 and HR 1.17, 95% CI: 1.02 - 1.35, respectively). These findings were consistent across the US and Chinese cohorts. The Causal SurvivalNet model accurately generated personalized survival curves, achieving strong performance with integrated Brier scores of 0.15, 0.076, and 0.16 at different time points. This clinical tool is accessible at https://bicarbonate.deepsurvival.cc/. 

Conclusion: We identified reproducible serum bicarbonate thresholds (≤24 and >33 mEq/L) at ICU admission that are causally associated with in-hospital mortality across international cohorts. Our novel deep learning model, incorporating these thresholds and other causal variables, achieved superior performance in personalized survival prediction compared to conventional approaches. These findings highlight the utility of admission bicarbonate levels for early risk stratification and individualized outcome prediction in critically ill patients.

detail.title: Legal Entanglement

detail.abstract: Quantum entanglement is a phenomenon in which two physical systems are correlated in such a way that they appear to instantaneously affect one another, regardless of the distance between them. As commonly understood, Bell's Theorem famously demonstrates that any causal explanation of entanglement must discard either locality (the principle that nothing, including information, travels faster than light) or classical notions of realism (or both). Drawing on this concept, several legal scholars have metaphorically described 'entangled' legal concepts. For instance, if a state's highest court redefines the concept of 'foreseeability' in negligence law, this redefinition alters the concept of 'reasonable care' immediately in the eyes of the law. Godfrey (2024) is the first work to mathematically model entangled legal concepts, particularly in the context of legal interpretation. Here, we extend the quantification to the formulation and delineation of law (lawmaking) and the adjudication of law (judgment). In so doing, we connect legal entanglement to Sichelman's (2022) work on legal entropy, complexity, and the informational content of law. In addition to quantifying entanglement across various legal contexts, our approach provides broader insights. For example, it offers a more comprehensive analysis of the uses and limits of 'modularity' in law--specifically, the role legal boundaries (spatial or intangible) play in reducing information costs within legal systems. Moreover, we discuss how our model can improve theories of legal artificial intelligence. Finally, we explore the application of legal theory back to physics. If quantum physical entanglement operates analogously to legal entanglement, it requires discarding both locality and classical realism, though not in the manner commonly imagined.

detail.abstract: The development of modern economics began with Adam Smith when he published his book The Wealth of Nations (1776). This book introduces the basics of modern economics to create economic balance in the midst of the economic needs of the community that continue to grow. Bitcoin, as a peer-to-peer electronic money created by Satoshi Nakamoto in 2009, has parallels with the modern economy, namely a free market, labor sharing, individual economic freedom, limited role of government, and increased wealth through productivity.

title: Do Investors Get It Right? Reaction Bias to Earnings Calls

detail.title: Do Investors Get It Right? Reaction Bias to Earnings Calls
