title: NCTI is the New GILTI, and States Should Still Conform
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law and University of California, Davis - School of Law

detail.title: NCTI is the New GILTI, and States Should Still Conform

keywords: NCTI (Net Controlled Foreign Corporation Tested Income)

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-52
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This essay continues our series on corporate profit shifting by analyzing how states should respond to the federal One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which transformed GILTI into the new Net Controlled Foreign Corporation Tested Income (NCTI) regime. We argue that states should conform to this new federal provision as a reasonable and legally sound approach to combatting the persistent profit shifting that erodes state tax bases. The 60 percent inclusion rate for NCTI effectively serves as a practical, "rough justice" estimate of income that was economically generated domestically but improperly shifted offshore — an estimate supported by empirical research. We also explain why the elimination of the QBAI deduction does not weaken the case for conformity. For taxpayers who believe this 60 percent default rule is not apt for their specific circumstances, states already provide safety valves, such as alternative apportionment petitions or elective worldwide combined reporting. We conclude that conforming to NCTI is a practical and essential tool for states to protect their revenue, and is far superior to water's-edge approaches that effectively surrender to corporate tax avoidance.

AI.tldr: 本文主张各州应采纳联邦的NCTI制度作为应对企业利润转移的合理法律方案，认为60%的纳入率是对国内经济产生但被不当转移至海外的收入的实用估计，并解释了为何取消QBAI扣除不削弱一致性理由。
AI.research_question: 各州应如何应对联邦的NCTI制度以应对企业利润转移问题？
AI.motivation: 企业利润转移持续侵蚀州税基，需要有效的应对措施
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收一致性理论、利润转移理论、税基保护理论
AI.method: 法律分析和政策论证
AI.findings: NCTI的60%纳入率是对国内经济产生但被不当转移至海外的收入的合理估计，各州采纳NCTI制度是保护税收收入的有效工具
AI.theory_contributions: 为州级税收政策一致性提供了理论支持，完善了应对利润转移的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州制定税收政策提供具体建议，帮助保护州税基免受企业避税侵蚀

title: Restricting Sales of Flavored Nicotine Vaping Products: Effects on Cigarette and Nicotine Vaping Product Sales in Canada
affiliations: University of Missouri, Yale School of Public Health and University of Missouri - Department of Economics

detail.title: Restricting Sales of Flavored Nicotine Vaping Products: Effects on Cigarette and Nicotine Vaping Product Sales in Canada
detail.abstract: The rise of nicotine vaping products (NVPs) has led governments to consider banning or limiting flavored NVP sales to reduce their appeal. In particular, we study the effect of NVP flavor restrictions enacted in Canada, a country with historically high tobacco regulation, through July of 2023. Using a stacked DID model, we estimate that flavor restrictions increased cigarette sales by 9.6%. In gas and convenience stores, these restrictions nearly eliminated flavored non-menthol and menthol NVP sales while increasing tobacco and unflavored NVP sales by 123.4%. Substitution patterns arise in Canada despite its strict tobacco control environment, suggesting that patterns of substitution between e-cigarettes and cigarettes are generalizable across countries with different tobacco regulatory strengths.

AI.tldr: 加拿大实施电子烟口味限制后，香烟销量增加9.6%，同时烟草味和无味电子烟销量激增123.4%，表明电子烟和香烟之间存在替代关系。
AI.research_question: 加拿大实施尼古丁电子烟产品口味限制对香烟和电子烟销售的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着尼古丁电子烟产品的兴起，政府考虑禁止或限制调味电子烟销售以减少其吸引力，但需要评估这种政策的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于替代效应理论，研究政策干预下不同烟草产品之间的消费替代模式。
AI.method: 使用堆叠双重差分模型分析加拿大截至2023年7月实施的口味限制政策效果。
AI.findings: 口味限制使香烟销量增加9.6%，在加油站和便利店几乎消除了调味非薄荷和薄荷电子烟销售，同时烟草味和无味电子烟销量增加123.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明即使在严格烟草控制环境下，电子烟和香烟之间的替代模式仍然存在，表明这种替代关系在不同烟草监管强度的国家具有普遍性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，表明限制电子烟口味可能导致消费者转向传统香烟，需要在制定烟草控制政策时考虑这种替代效应。

title: Hybrid Centralized and Distributed Approaches to Automatic Service and Protection Path Computation
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA, Unaffiliated Author, Unaffiliated Author, Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Hybrid Centralized and Distributed Approaches to Automatic Service and Protection Path Computation
detail.abstract: The evolution of modern telecommunication networks, driven by exponentially growing traffic demands and the stringent requirements of services like 5G and the Internet of Things (IoT), necessitates highly efficient and resilient path computation methodologies. Traditional networking paradigms relied either on fully centralized control planes, which offer global optimality but suffer from scalability and single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities, or purely distributed approaches, which provide resilience but lead to sub-optimal path selection due to localized information. This paper addresses the fundamental challenge of balancing optimal resource utilization with robust, scalable network operation by analyzing hybrid centralized and distributed approaches to automatic service and protection path computation. Specifically, this research reviews the theoretical foundation, architectural frameworks (such as the Hierarchical Path Computation Element (H-PCE) and hybrid Software-Defined Networking (SDN)), and performance trade-offs of these hybrid models. Through simulated analysis utilizing industry-standard network topologies (NSFNet and EON), the hybrid model is demonstrated to minimize path costs and reduce recovery time, successfully combining the centralized view necessary for global optimization with the distributed execution essential for network resilience. The findings suggest that hybrid control planes, particularly those employing a centralized control/distributed execution division of labor, represent the optimal architectural design for next-generation, high-availability service provisioning.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了混合集中式和分布式路径计算方法，通过模拟验证混合模型能最小化路径成本并减少恢复时间，结合了全局优化的集中视图和网络弹性的分布式执行。
AI.research_question: 如何在保证网络弹性和可扩展性的同时实现最优资源利用？
AI.motivation: 传统网络范式要么完全集中控制（全局最优但可扩展性差），要么完全分布式（弹性好但路径选择次优），需要平衡两者的混合方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层路径计算元素（H-PCE）和混合软件定义网络（SDN）架构框架
AI.method: 使用行业标准网络拓扑（NSFNet和EON）进行模拟分析
AI.findings: 混合模型能最小化路径成本并减少恢复时间，成功结合了全局优化的集中视图和网络弹性的分布式执行
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合控制平面作为下一代高可用服务提供的最优架构设计
AI.practical_contributions: 为5G和物联网等服务的路径计算提供了高效且弹性的解决方案

title: Who Drives What? Examining the Link between the Prevalence of Anaemia and Intimate Partner Violence Among Married Women in India
affiliations: Jawaharlal Nehru University - Centre for the Study of Regional Development, Indian Statistical Institute, BML Munjal University and Jawaharlal Nehru University - Centre for the Study of Regional Development

detail.title: Who Drives What? Examining the Link between the Prevalence of Anaemia and Intimate Partner Violence Among Married Women in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We jointly declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: We are thankful for the project grant received from the Planning and Policy Research Unit (PPRU), Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), Delhi, which enabled us to undertake the research. However, any errors are exclusively our own.

detail.abstract: The widespread prevalence of anaemia and intimate partner violence (IPV) among ever-married women are two of the most significant and persistent challenges to women's health and gender equality in the global South, particularly in India. This paper addresses a major gap in the literature by investigating a novel and provocative hypothesis: that a woman's anaemic status may serve as a potential trigger for her exposure to IPV. To test this causal hypothesis, we employ a rigorous econometric approach using the latest round of India’s nationally representative National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019–21) database. We adopt an instrumental variable approach and estimate the causal effect by using Conditional Mixed Processes (CMP), a technique well-suited for models with binary endogenous and outcome variables. Our estimation indicates anaemic women are 4.0 percentage points (pp) more likely to face violence by their intimate partner as compared to non-anaemic women. The effect size is significantly higher in the case of physical violence (4.9 pp), but positive and borderline significant for sexual violence (1.1 pp) and an insignificant positive effect in the case of emotional violence. The robustness of the findings is extensively tested using alternative estimators (Two-Stage Least Squares and Control Function Approach). Estimates from a series of sub-sample analyses indicate compelling heterogeneity in our results, establishing that the effect of anaemia is significantly stronger among disadvantaged categories of women.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用印度全国代表性调查数据，通过工具变量方法发现贫血女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力的风险比非贫血女性高4.0个百分点，其中身体暴力风险增加4.9个百分点。
AI.research_question: 女性的贫血状况是否会成为其遭受亲密伴侣暴力的潜在触发因素？
AI.motivation: 贫血和亲密伴侣暴力是影响全球南方女性健康和性别平等的两个重要且持续存在的挑战，特别是在印度。现有文献存在重要空白，需要检验贫血作为IPV触发因素的新颖假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康与暴力关系的理论框架，探讨贫血状况如何可能成为亲密伴侣暴力的风险因素。
AI.method: 使用印度国家家庭健康调查（NFHS-5）数据，采用工具变量方法和条件混合过程（CMP）估计，同时使用两阶段最小二乘法和控制函数方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 贫血女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力的可能性比非贫血女性高4.0个百分点；身体暴力风险增加4.9个百分点，性暴力风险增加1.1个百分点（边缘显著），情感暴力影响不显著。弱势女性群体中影响更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并验证了贫血作为亲密伴侣暴力触发因素的新颖假设，为理解健康与暴力关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生干预提供了重要证据，表明贫血治疗可能有助于减少亲密伴侣暴力，特别是针对弱势女性群体。

title: Automatic Service and Protection Multiplexing in Multi-Cloud Network Infrastructures: An SDN/NFV-Enabled Optimization Approach
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA, Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Automatic Service and Protection Multiplexing in Multi-Cloud Network Infrastructures: An SDN/NFV-Enabled Optimization Approach
detail.abstract: The proliferation of distributed applications and stringent Service Level Agreements (SLAs) necessitates highly resilient networking infrastructure spanning multiple independent cloud domains. Providing survivability in these multi-cloud environments traditionally relies on 1:1 dedicated resource protection, a strategy that results in substantial operational and capital expenditure overheads, fundamentally undermining the cost benefits derived from virtualization. 1 This article addresses the critical challenge of optimizing resource utilization without compromising service availability by proposing the Automatic Service and Protection Multiplexing in Multi-Cloud (ASPMC-MC) framework. The ASPMC-MC framework adapts the foundational principle of capacity sharing in protection path computation (Loay, Ammar, and Jaafar 2012), extending it to dynamic, virtualized network function (VNF) chains deployed across heterogeneous public and private cloud environments. The framework leverages the centralized, programmatic control inherent in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) to achieve the global network visibility required for failure-domain-disjoint path calculation and effective protection resource multiplexing. Through synthetic simulation analysis, the ASPMC-MC framework demonstrates significant improvements in the Resource Utilization Ratio (RUR). Specifically, results show a 48% reduction in the total weighted resource cost compared to dedicated protection schemes, primarily driven by efficiency gains in inter-cloud bandwidth utilization (Ammar et al. 2018). This validates the framework as a crucial mechanism for translating the theoretical cost savings of network virtualization into practical, survivable multi-cloud deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPMC-MC框架，通过在多云环境中实现服务和保护资源的复用，显著提高资源利用率，相比专用保护方案降低48%的总加权资源成本。
AI.research_question: 如何在多云环境中优化资源利用率而不影响服务可用性？
AI.motivation: 传统1:1专用资源保护策略在多云环境中导致高昂的运营和资本支出，削弱了虚拟化的成本优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于保护路径计算中的容量共享原理，扩展到动态虚拟化网络功能链在多云环境中的应用。
AI.method: 利用SDN的集中式编程控制实现全局网络可见性，进行故障域分离路径计算和有效保护资源复用。
AI.findings: ASPMC-MC框架显著提高资源利用率比率，相比专用保护方案降低48%的总加权资源成本，主要得益于跨云带宽利用效率的提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 将保护路径计算中的容量共享原理扩展到动态虚拟化网络功能链在多云环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为将网络虚拟化的理论成本节约转化为实际可生存的多云部署提供了关键机制。

title: Aggregate Savings in India: Where Do We Go from Here?
affiliations: and

detail.title: Aggregate Savings in India: Where Do We Go from Here?
detail.abstract: The savings rate in the Indian economy has declined sharply since 2007 and approached a low of 29% of GDP in 2020. In this paper, we take a closer look at the historical evolution of aggregate savings in India, as well as its different components. We use a simple framework that seeks to explain the time variation in savings over the sample period. We find that increased prosperity more than explains the decline in savings of Indian households, while the decline in old age dependency was a major offset. Our baseline forecast implies a roughly 2 percentage point decline in household savings as a fraction of GDP over the next five years. We build some medium term scenarios to understand the trade-offs going forward.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度储蓄率自2007年以来的显著下降，发现家庭财富增加是储蓄下降的主要原因，而老年抚养比下降起到了抵消作用。预测未来五年家庭储蓄占GDP比例将下降约2个百分点。
AI.research_question: 印度总储蓄率下降的原因是什么？未来储蓄率将如何演变？
AI.motivation: 印度经济储蓄率自2007年以来急剧下降，2020年降至GDP的29%的低点，需要深入分析这一趋势的原因和未来走向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用解释储蓄时间变化的简单分析框架，考察不同因素对储蓄率的影响。
AI.method: 分析印度总储蓄及其不同组成部分的历史演变，使用时间序列分析方法解释储蓄变化。
AI.findings: 家庭财富增加是印度家庭储蓄下降的主要原因，而老年抚养比下降起到了重要的抵消作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了印度储蓄率下降的实证解释框架，识别了关键影响因素的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供储蓄率预测和中期情景分析，帮助理解未来政策权衡。

title: Skill-Integrated Machine Coefficient Model (SIMCM): Resolving Capital Aggregation Challenges and Policy Insights
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Skill-Integrated Machine Coefficient Model (SIMCM): Resolving Capital Aggregation Challenges and Policy Insights

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Skill-Integrated Machine Coefficient Model (SIMCM), a novel framework designed to resolve the long-standing Cambridge Capital Controversy (CCC) by integrating heterogeneous capital, skill dynamics, and sustainability considerations into a unified growth model. Traditional growth models oversimplify aggregation by neglecting variations in machine efficiency, skill availability, and environmental factors (Cohen & Harcourt, 2003). SIMCM formalizes machine coefficients (αᵢ) and skill factors (σᵢ) using weighted and multiplicative forms, enabling accurate aggregation without ignoring heterogeneity (Baqaee & Farhi, 2019; Felipe & Fisher, 2003). Through a simulated dataset, SIMCM achieves a superior fit (R² ≈ 0.99998) compared to the Cobb-Douglas framework (Temple, 2006). A case study of India's textile sector demonstrates that targeted skill investments can raise potential growth by 12%. The framework offers direct policy relevance by linking skill development, sustainable machine adoption, and productivity enhancement, making it a robust and practical tool for policymakers and researchers alike.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了技能集成机器系数模型(SIMCM)，通过整合异质性资本、技能动态和可持续性考量来解决剑桥资本争议，相比传统模型能更准确地聚合异质要素，并在实证中展现了优越的拟合效果和政策应用价值。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够解决剑桥资本争议、整合异质性资本、技能动态和可持续性考量的统一增长模型？
AI.motivation: 传统增长模型在资本聚合时过度简化，忽视了机器效率差异、技能可获得性和环境因素等异质性特征，导致理论框架存在局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cohen & Harcourt (2003)、Baqaee & Farhi (2019)、Felipe & Fisher (2003)等关于资本异质性和聚合问题的理论基础，构建机器系数(αᵢ)和技能因子(σᵢ)的加权乘数形式。
AI.method: 采用模拟数据集进行模型验证，并与Cobb-Douglas框架进行比较；同时以印度纺织业为案例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: SIMCM在模拟数据中达到R²≈0.99998的优越拟合度；印度纺织业案例显示针对性技能投资可使潜在增长提升12%。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了剑桥资本争议中的资本聚合问题，提供了整合异质性资本、技能动态和可持续性考量的统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了连接技能发展、可持续机器采用和生产力提升的直接政策工具，具有显著的实际应用价值。

title: Survivability-Focused Multiplexing Techniques for Service Path Protection in Cloud-Native Data Center Interconnects
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA, Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH), Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Survivability-Focused Multiplexing Techniques for Service Path Protection in Cloud-Native Data Center Interconnects
detail.abstract: Modern digital operations, increasingly reliant on distributed computing and high-volume data exchange, necessitate ultra-reliable Data Center Interconnect (DCI) infrastructure. 1 While survivability, or resiliency, is defined by the system's ability to maintain operation despite catastrophic failure, the massive scale of cloud-native DCI requires protection mechanisms that balance guaranteed, near-instantaneous recovery with economically sustainable resource utilization. 2 This report addresses the fundamental conflict between the resource overhead inherent in dedicated protection schemes and the non-negotiable requirement for fast restoration-specifically, maintaining the legacy sub-50-millisecond (ms) recovery benchmark. 4 This investigation proposes the Optimized Protection Path Multiplexing (OPPM) heuristic, a Survivability-Focused Multiplexing Technique (SFMT) designed for Elastic Optical Networks (EONs). 5 Utilizing synthetic simulation data on a representative mesh topology, OPPM is shown to significantly reduce the Resource Overhead Ratio to an average of by maximizing backup capacity sharing through Resource Sharing Degree Constraints (RSDCs). 6 Crucially, the approach ensures the Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) remains safely below ms, validating that resource efficiency can be achieved without compromising strict service-level agreement (SLA) mandated protection speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OPPM启发式算法，这是一种针对弹性光网络的生存性聚焦复用技术，能够在保证50毫秒内恢复的同时显著降低资源开销比。
AI.research_question: 如何在弹性光网络中平衡资源开销与快速恢复需求之间的冲突？
AI.motivation: 现代数据中心互连需要超可靠的基础设施，但专用保护方案的高资源开销与必须维持的50毫秒内恢复基准存在根本性冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生存性（系统在灾难性故障下维持运行的能力）和弹性光网络理论框架。
AI.method: 提出优化保护路径复用（OPPM）启发式算法，采用资源共享度约束（RSDC）最大化备份容量共享，使用代表性网格拓扑的合成仿真数据进行验证。
AI.findings: OPPM能够显著降低资源开销比，同时确保平均恢复时间（MTTR）安全低于50毫秒。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了生存性聚焦复用技术（SFMT）理论框架，为弹性光网络的保护机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种经济可持续的资源利用方案，在不影响严格服务水平协议要求的前提下实现资源效率优化。

title: Cross-Layer Design for Efficient Service and Protection Path Computation in Satellite-Terrestrial Integrated Networks
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA, Unaffiliated Author, Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Cross-Layer Design for Efficient Service and Protection Path Computation in Satellite-Terrestrial Integrated Networks
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the critical challenge of simultaneous Service and Protection Path Computation (SPPC) in highly dynamic Satellite-Terrestrial Integrated Networks (STINs). Traditional layered routing protocols, constrained by the rigid boundaries of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model, fail to account for the rapid variations in link quality (Physical layer, PHY) and node congestion (Medium Access Control layer, MAC) inherent to heterogeneous Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) constellations (Wei and Li 2017; Zhang, Liu, and Li 2016). A novel Cross-Layer Service and Protection Path Computation (CL-SPPC) framework is proposed. This framework utilizes joint PHY/MAC layer state feedback to inform Network layer routing decisions, formulating the problem as a multi-objective optimization seeking minimum end-to-end delay and maximized resource-disjoint survivability, subject to dynamic capacity and congestion constraints. Analytical modeling and simulated data comparisons demonstrate that CL-SPPC significantly outperforms conventional layered routing, enhancing path computation success rates and reducing mean restoration time by leveraging real-time network conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的跨层服务与保护路径计算框架，用于解决卫星-地面集成网络中动态链路质量和节点拥塞的挑战，相比传统分层路由协议显著提升了路径计算成功率和恢复时间。
AI.research_question: 如何在高度动态的卫星-地面集成网络中实现同时的服务与保护路径计算？
AI.motivation: 传统分层路由协议受限于OSI模型的刚性边界，无法适应异构LEO和MEO星座中链路质量和节点拥塞的快速变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨层路由理论，结合物理层和MAC层状态反馈来指导网络层路由决策。
AI.method: 多目标优化方法，寻求最小端到端延迟和最大化资源分离生存能力，受动态容量和拥塞约束。
AI.findings: CL-SPPC框架显著优于传统分层路由，提高了路径计算成功率并减少了平均恢复时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨层服务与保护路径计算的理论框架，突破了传统OSI模型的限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卫星-地面集成网络提供了更有效的路由解决方案，能够更好地适应动态网络条件。

title: Large-Scale Functional Network Time Series Model Solved with Mathematical Programming Approach
affiliations: Zuse Institute Berlin and Zuse Institute Berlin

detail.title: Large-Scale Functional Network Time Series Model Solved with Mathematical Programming Approach
detail.abstract: A functional network autoregressive model is proposed for studying largescale network time series observed at high temporal resolution. The model incorporates high-dimensional curves to capture both serial and cross-sectional dependence in large-scale network functional time series. Estimation of the model is approached using a Mixed Integer Optimization method. Simulation studies confirm the consistency of parameter and adjacency matrix estimation. The method is applied to data from a real-life natural gas supply network. Compared to alternative prediction models, the proposed model delivers more accurate day-ahead hourly out-of-sample forecasts of the gas inflows and outflows at most gas nodes.

title: The (In)effectiveness of Targeted Payroll Tax Reductions
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Department of Economics,  and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The (In)effectiveness of Targeted Payroll Tax Reductions

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper studies the cost-effectiveness of targeted payroll taxes for stimulating labor demand. It uses rich administrative data to study the effects of an Italian reform that raised social security contributions for apprenticeship contracts but granted a substantial discount for firms with 9 employees or less. The discount does not increase demand for apprenticeship contracts. Instead, it subsidizes inframarginal hiring. This reform is not cost-effective. Point estimates imply that each million euros of foregone social security contributions supports the employment of 29 apprentices for one year and no permanent contracts (these estimates are not statistically different from zero).

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

detail.title: The Impact of Global Oil Price Shocks on Nepal's Foreign Exchange Reserves and Inflation

detail.abstract:
This study examines the dynamic, interlinked effects of global oil price shocks on Nepal's foreign exchange reserves and domestic price levels, addressing a gap in the Nepal-specific econometric literature. As a small, import-dependent economy with a pegged exchange rate, Nepal is acutely vulnerable to volatile crude oil prices, which threaten macroeconomic stability through elevated import bills and external imbalances.

Employing a Vector Autoregression (VAR) model with annual time-series data from 1979 to 2021, the analysis focuses on the second differences of real Global Oil Price and real Foreign Exchange Reserves to ensure stationarity. The model employed a VAR(4) specification, consistent with the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), Hannan-Quinn (HQ), and Final Prediction Error (FPE) lag selection criteria. Diagnostic checks confirmed the model's statistical reliability, showing that the residuals are serially uncorrelated and homoskedastic. The results of the Granger causality test establish a unidirectional causal relationship: fluctuations in the Global Oil Price Granger-cause changes in the Foreign Exchange Reserve, but the reverse causality is not found.

The study concludes that global oil price shocks pose a significant and dynamic threat to Nepal's foreign exchange reserves, with the effect peaking two years after the shock. Nepal's fuel price stabilization policies and pegged exchange rate regime mitigate direct inflationary impacts but shift the primary burden of adjustment to its reserves, accounting for approximately one-third of reserve volatility. These findings underscore the critical need for policy strategies such as proactive reserve accumulation, energy diversification, and a balanced fuel pricing mechanism to strengthen macroeconomic resilience.

title: Employment Relationships, Wage Setting, and Labor Market Power
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Arizona State University (ASU) - Economics Department, University of Lausanne and KU Leuven - Department of Economics

detail.title: Employment Relationships, Wage Setting, and Labor Market Power

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We ask to what extent the quantification of labor market power depends on the modeling of the long-term worker-firm employment relationship. We develop an oligopsony model with dynamic wage contracts. Workers decide whether and where to work, choosing among firms providing different amenities and solving a dynamic discrete choice labor supply problem with firm-specific human capital. As a result, firms optimally choose wage-tenure contracts to attract and retain workers. We find that such contracts mitigate firms' incentives to impose large instantaneous wage markdowns—compared to standard static wage-setting models—thereby reducing the share of socially inefficient worker-firm separations. As a consequence, we show that the empirical approaches based on "sufficient statistics" tend to overestimate the extent of labor market power: low levels of firm-specific labor supply elasticities do not necessarily indicate rent extraction, but instead reflect firms’ ability to retain workers by offering long-term value through human capital accumulation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Active Machine Learning Based Trading and Mutual Fund Performance
affiliations: , NHH - Norwegian School of Economics and Washington State University

detail.title: Active Machine Learning Based Trading and Mutual Fund Performance
detail.abstract: We propose a novel Active Machine Learning Based Trading (AMLT) measure, a signed active-share measure conditional on forward-looking ML trading signals, to comprehensively examine the utilization of ML by U.S. equity mutual funds to enhance performance. We document a significant rising trend in AMLT adoption, with top-decile AMLT funds outperforming bottom-decile funds by 2.4% to 3.0% annually on a risk-adjusted basis. This outperformance is decomposed into superior stock selection, lower expenses, and efficient trading cost management, despite the inherently high turnover of ML-based strategies. We identify two key drivers of superior performance. Linear quasi-ML models or reduced information sets deliver at most half the performance of full AMLT, highlighting ML's ability to process information and capture complex interactions as a key determinant. Further, managers' ability to integrate ML with human expertise contributes to sustained performance over long horizons, across different market conditions, and investment styles. Finally, a comprehensive analysis of AI talent of mutual fund employees provides validation to our measure and complements our analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的基于主动机器学习的交易指标(AMLT)，用于评估美国股票共同基金使用机器学习提升业绩的情况。研究发现采用AMLT的基金呈现显著上升趋势，前十分位基金相比后十分位基金每年风险调整后超额收益达2.4%-3.0%。优异表现源于更好的选股能力、更低费用和高效交易成本管理。

title: Africa Rising: The case for Prioritizing East Africa in U.S. Strategic Economic Planning

detail.title: Africa Rising: The case for Prioritizing East Africa in U.S. Strategic Economic Planning
detail.abstract: This policy paper presents a compelling case for reorienting U.S. strategic economic planning to prioritize East Africa, particularly Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Ethiopia. With over 460 million people, a median age below 20, and rapidly expanding urban centers, East Africa is poised to become a powerful engine of global growth (UN DESA, 2022). Its economic sectors, agribusiness, information and communication technologies (ICT), logistics, renewable energy, and healthcare, align directly with U.S. commercial and development priorities (AfDB, 2021; World Bank, 2023). However, U.S. engagement remains fragmented and under-leveraged, especially compared to the aggressive economic diplomacy of China, the European Union, and Gulf States (Brookings Institution, 2022). Programs like AGOA, Prosper Africa, and Power Africa have laid foundations but lack the depth, flexibility, and alignment needed to maximize regional impact (USAID, 2023). This report proposes a new framework of U.S.-East Africa cooperation, built on investment incentives, robust trade agreements, diaspora capital mobilization, and high-level commercial diplomacy. Policy recommendations include expanding bilateral air and trade agreements, targeting blended finance for infrastructure and SME growth, supporting regional economic corridors, and investing in digital governance and renewable energy platforms (USTDA, 2022).

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34438
title: Environmental Catastrophe and the Direction of Invention: Evidence from the American Dust Bowl
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Environmental Catastrophe and the Direction of Invention: Evidence from the American Dust Bowl

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper investigates how innovation responded to and shaped the economic impact of the American Dust Bowl, an environmental catastrophe that led to widespread soil erosion on the US Plains during the 1930s. Combining data on county-level erosion, the historical geography of crop production, and crop-specific innovation, I document that in the wake of the environmental crisis, agricultural technology development was strongly and persistently re-directed toward more Dust Bowl-exposed crops and, within crops, toward bio-chemical and planting technologies that could directly mitigate economic losses from environmental distress. County-level exposure to Dust Bowl-induced innovation significantly dampened the effect of land erosion on agricultural land values and revenue. These results highlight the role of crises in spurring innovation and the importance of endogenous technological progress as an adaptive force in the face of disasters.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: From Institutions to Families: Uzbekistan's Path Toward Family-Type Children's Homes and Child Welfare Reform

detail.title: From Institutions to Families: Uzbekistan's Path Toward Family-Type Children's Homes and Child Welfare Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with the In-Service Training Center under the National Agency for Social Protection (NASP), Uzbekistan. The views expressed in this paper are solely those of the author and do not necessarily represent the official position of NASP or UNICEF. The author declares no other conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: While many developed nations face demographic decline, Uzbekistan experiences an opposite phenomenon—welcoming more than 2,000 children each day. Such rapid growth presents a unique responsibility for the state: ensuring that every child grows up in a nurturing family environment. Over the last two years, Uzbekistan has taken decisive steps to replace institutional care with family-type children’s homes, following the global deinstitutionalisation movement. Guided by Decree No. 893 (2024), the government has closed punitive facilities for children, restructured guardianship authorities, and empowered “Inson” social service centers to coordinate placements under the National Agency for Social Protection (NASP). Drawing on Sammon (2024), UNICEF (2024), and the INSPIRE framework (WHO, 2016), this paper analyses the transition toward family-based care, situating Uzbekistan’s reforms within international human-rights frameworks and evidence-based child-protection strategies. It argues that the new legal and institutional architecture positions Uzbekistan to become a regional model for deinstitutionalisation and child-welfare reform—if sustained by workforce development, community gatekeeping, and social-norm change.

title: In what ways do Vocational Training Institutes Enhance the Human Development Index (HDI), Particularly Through Collaboration with Industries?

detail.title: In what ways do Vocational Training Institutes Enhance the Human Development Index (HDI), Particularly Through Collaboration with Industries?
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of vocational training institutes in enhancing the Human Development Index (HDI) by fostering industry partnerships that improve employment outcomes and quality of life. It highlights how vocational education, tailored to industry needs, equips individuals with essential skills, increasing their employability and income levels. The analysis covers various global models, such as Germany's dual training system, and their impact on economic growth, social inclusion, and technological innovation. The paper argues that vocational training is pivotal in reducing inequality and promoting sustainable development by providing marginalised communities access to education and employment opportunities.

title: Failure of Financial Inclusion in Africa: The Case of Côte d'Ivoire
affiliations: University of London

detail.title: Failure of Financial Inclusion in Africa: The Case of Côte d'Ivoire
detail.abstract:
Financial inclusion in Côte d’Ivoire remains low despite ongoing reforms and modernization of the financial sector. This article aims to understand the causes of this failure and to analyze the alternative forms of financial inclusion that have developed, such as microfinance, mobile money, tontines, and fintechs. The study adopts both an analytical and empirical approach to highlight the economic, social, cultural, institutional, and technological factors that influence access to financial services.

An empirical analysis conducted on a regional sample shows an inverse correlation between the use of mobile money and traditional banking, while income and urbanization remain determining variables. These results confirm that alternative financial instruments are better suited to low-income populations and rural areas, where traditional banks remain scarce.

The article advocates for the construction of a hybrid model combining the stability of the banking system with the flexibility and proximity of community-based and digital solutions. It nevertheless acknowledges certain limitations related to the small sample size, the use of online data, and the short duration of analysis. This research is intended as a contribution to the discourse on the emergence of an African finance that is rooted in local realities and oriented towards inclusion.

title: Temptation to Consume Information
affiliations: University of Cambridge

detail.title: Temptation to Consume Information

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was given ethics approval by the board at the Faculty of Economics, University of Cambridge.
declarations.funderStatement: The experiment was funded by a grant from the Keynes Fund at the University of Cambridge.

detail.abstract: Avoiding information can be desirable for individuals. We use an experiment to show that temptation can be an important barrier to this strategy. 75% of individuals who would like to avoid undesirable information in a day's time are also willing to pay for a commitment device that entirely eliminates it from their choice set. As in other studies of temptation, only a small share of individuals make dynamically inconsistent choices when offered the temptation against their preferences. However, we construct a novel analysis of self-control costs using response times and find evidence that commitment demand is motivated by costly self-control.

AI.tldr: 实验研究表明，诱惑是阻碍人们避免不良信息的重要障碍。75%希望避免不良信息的个体愿意付费购买承诺机制来完全消除这种诱惑。虽然只有少数个体在面临诱惑时会做出与偏好不一致的选择，但通过反应时间分析发现，对承诺机制的需求源于高成本的自我控制。
AI.research_question: 诱惑如何影响个体避免不良信息的能力？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么个体难以避免不良信息，以及诱惑在其中扮演的角色
AI.theoretical_framework: 诱惑理论、自我控制成本理论、承诺机制理论
AI.method: 实验研究，通过反应时间测量自我控制成本
AI.findings: 75%希望避免不良信息的个体愿意付费使用承诺机制；只有少数个体会做出动态不一致选择；反应时间分析显示承诺需求源于高自我控制成本
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于反应时间的自我控制成本测量方法；扩展了诱惑理论在信息回避领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计有效的信息回避工具提供了实证依据；揭示了承诺机制在帮助个体克服信息诱惑中的价值

The Automation of Manufacturing Industries Leads to Joblessness among the Middle And Lower Socioeconomic Groups

detail.abstract: This policy brief examines the impact of post-2018 U.S. tariff policies, supply chain diversions, and upstream clean technology inputs on household expenses and labor demand. Using recent empirical research on tariff pass-through, data on customs duty receipts, and trade reports about diversion to third-country hubs, I argue that tariffs primarily serve as an indirect consumption tax with limited effects on widespread employment in routine manufacturing. Case evidence from Wisconsin's discontinued LCD project (later repurposed for a large AI data center) illustrates the concept of 'megadeal execution risk.' Simultaneously, China's dominance in battery supply chains and mineral processing strengthens its upstream leverage, maintaining high costs in the short term. From a societal perspective, ongoing incarceration rates and high recidivism, along with scaled mental health prescriptions in peer countries, demonstrate continued demand for re-entry services and behavioral health capacity. I outline a practical timeline from 2018 to 2045 and recommend system-level responses, including integrating strategic trade measures with efforts to rebuild supplier ecosystems, implementing short-term skills development focused on automation, and employing evidence-based approaches for behavioral health- all while maintaining neutral, system-first language to reduce politicization.

AI.method: 基于关税转嫁的实证研究、海关税收数据、贸易报告分析、威斯康星州LCD项目案例研究
AI.findings: 关税主要作为间接消费税，对常规制造业就业影响有限；中国在电池供应链中的主导地位维持了短期高成本；存在持续的再就业服务和行为健康服务需求

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There were no competing interests. This research was conducted independently and was not influenced by any personal, financial, or institutional relationships.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a reflective and conceptual analysis that does not involve direct research with human participants. Therefore, ethics approval was not required. All referenced information was obtained from publicly available sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was entirely self-initiated and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Stereotypes shape how individuals perceive themselves and others, often dictating what emotions are acceptable and what identities are suppressed. This paper offers a socio-psychological reflection on harmful masculinity stereotypes and their mental health implications, exploring how these cultural expectations quietly erode men's emotional freedom across societies. Using a reflective and conceptual approach, it draws on personal experience, social observation, and global mental health insights to examine the silent pressure on men to embody strength while denying vulnerability. The reflection highlights how such expectations foster emotional repression, increase psychological distress, and sustain cycles of unhealthy masculinity. It further acknowledges how these patterns manifest in different societies, narrowing briefly on the Nigerian context as a microcosm of a global reality. Ultimately, this work calls for a redefinition of masculinity-one that allows empathy, openness, and emotional authenticity to coexist with strength, paving the way for healthier minds and a more humane world.

title: Put Option Trading Efficiency
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics (UIBE)

detail.title: Put Option Trading Efficiency
detail.abstract: We develop a monthly "Put Option Trading Efficiency"(POTE) variable to measure the extent to which put option trades are executed on the mispriced stocks. We show: (i) POTE significantly and negatively predicts the stock market returns both in-sample and out-of-sample, which cannot be explained by other predictors; (ii) The predictive power is stronger during periods of high volatility, recessions, opaque information, as well as when short selling is inefficient, costly, and risky; (iii) Low POTE is followed by months with well-performing CAPM, the proxy for market efficiency; (iv) There is no predictability when using call options to construct the measure.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个月度"看跌期权交易效率"(POTE)变量来衡量看跌期权交易在错误定价股票上的执行程度。研究发现POTE能显著负向预测股市回报，这种预测能力在波动率高、经济衰退、信息不透明以及卖空效率低时更强。
AI.research_question: 看跌期权交易效率(POTE)能否预测股票市场回报？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个衡量期权交易在错误定价股票上执行程度的指标，以检验其对市场回报的预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论和期权定价理论，假设看跌期权交易能反映市场对股票错误定价的认知。
AI.method: 开发月度POTE变量，进行样本内和样本外预测分析，控制其他预测因子，并分析不同市场条件下的预测能力差异。
AI.findings: POTE显著负向预测股市回报，预测能力在波动率高、经济衰退、信息不透明和卖空效率低时更强；低POTE后市场效率指标表现更好；看涨期权构建的类似指标无预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的市场效率衡量指标POTE，深化了对期权交易信息含量的理解，扩展了市场预测理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了新的市场预测工具，有助于在市场不确定性高时做出更好的投资决策，对监管机构评估市场效率也有参考价值。

detail.title: Extraterritoriality in AI: Harmonizing the Digital Market Act and US Antitrust Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Vanderbilt Journal of Transnational Law, Volume 58, No. 4 pp. 1055-1110

detail.abstract:
International AI markets currently operate under divergent and often conflicting competition laws. This splintered approach fosters uncertainty, invites regulatory failure, and risks entrenching dominant firms at the expense of emerging innovators. This Note proposes harmonized enforcement mechanisms to safeguard fair competition and minimize extraterritorial effects on global AI platforms. Recent academic discourse has discussed the domestic effects of ex ante regulations in AI markets, but international harmonization and extraterritoriality remain largely undiscussed. 

This Note proposes treaty-based coordination and uniform enforcement guidelines to ensure consistent international oversight. It synthesizes comparative insights from differing competition frameworks to identify best practices and encourage cross-border cooperation. In effect, this analysis closes jurisdictional gaps and mitigates risks of fragmented enforcement in rapidly expanding AI markets. The Note offers an actionable roadmap to unify competition laws globally, protect consumers, and foster continuing innovation.

title: Student-Athlete Abuse: Coaching and Institutional Failures from Past to Present
affiliations: Central Michigan University - Department of Finance and Law

detail.title: Student-Athlete Abuse: Coaching and Institutional Failures from Past to Present
detail.abstract: This article examines decades of student-athlete abuse in collegiate sports, highlighting systemic failures by coaches, institutions, and the NCAA. Through specific examples across major universities, it reveals patterns of physical, emotional, and sexual misconduct, hazing, and retaliation, often met with inadequate oversight. The analysis critiques the NCAA's limited authority and explores shifting dynamics in athlete rights, mobility, and public accountability. While acknowledging that not all allegations are legitimate, the article calls for enforceable standards, institutional transparency, and a cultural shift that prioritizes athlete safety over competitive success.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了几十年来大学体育中学生运动员遭受虐待的问题，揭示了教练、机构和NCAA的系统性失职。通过主要大学的实例，展示了身体、情感和性行为不当、欺凌和报复的模式，这些问题通常缺乏有效监管。文章批评了NCAA有限的权力，探讨了运动员权利、流动性和公共问责制的转变动态。
AI.research_question: 大学体育中学生运动员遭受虐待的系统性原因是什么？NCAA和高校机构在监管和保护运动员方面存在哪些制度性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 揭示大学体育中长期存在的学生运动员虐待问题，批判现有监管体系的不足，推动建立更有效的运动员保护机制。

detail.title: Money and Power
detail.abstract: Investments in electricity generation capacity incur substantial upfront costs and produce uncertain returns that can take years to materialize, making them highly dependent on external finance. We link loan-level regulatory data to power plant-level generation capacity and use two natural experiments to examine how financial frictions affect electricity producers' responses to taxes and subsidies. We find that increasing the cost of coal generation created spillovers through firms' internal capital markets and ultimately reduced investments in new solar capacity. We also find that subsidies designed to increase cash flows to early-stage projects disproportionately boosted solar capacity investments for financially constrained firms. These results highlight the importance of firms' financial frictions in understanding how policy can influence investments in electricity generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个自然实验发现，金融摩擦显著影响电力生产商对税收和补贴政策的反应。增加燃煤发电成本会通过企业内部资本市场产生溢出效应，最终减少对太阳能新产能的投资；而旨在增加早期项目现金流的补贴则对财务受限企业的太阳能投资有不成比例的促进作用。
AI.research_question: 金融摩擦如何影响电力生产商对税收和补贴政策的反应？
AI.motivation: 电力发电产能投资具有前期成本高、回报不确定且实现周期长的特点，因此高度依赖外部融资，但金融摩擦对政策效果的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融摩擦理论、企业内部资本市场理论，分析税收和补贴政策通过融资渠道影响电力投资决策的机制。
AI.method: 将贷款层面的监管数据与发电厂层面的产能数据关联，利用两个自然实验进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 增加燃煤发电成本通过企业内部资本市场产生负向溢出，减少太阳能新产能投资；2) 针对早期项目的现金补贴对财务受限企业的太阳能投资促进作用更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融摩擦在政策传导机制中的重要作用，扩展了对企业内部资本市场在能源投资中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的能源转型政策提供了重要启示，需要考虑企业财务约束对政策效果的调节作用。

title: Reinventing Patent Prosecution

detail.title: Reinventing Patent Prosecution

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston Univ. School of Law Research Paper No. 25-32
publicationDetails.journalName: Boston University School of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Many, if not most, patents are granted in error: they do not meet standards of patentability. Why? We argue that outdated procedures at the Patent Office—burdens for producing information for examination, standards for relevance, the format in which information is produced, and so on—are often responsible.  The Patent Office’s information procedures have not changed much since the enactment of the Patent Act of 1836 despite revolutions in technology, and the evolution of procedures for producing information elsewhere in the law. As other agencies have shifted more of the information burden on to the parties that come before them, the Patent Office continues to impose too much of the burden on examiners. Moreover, patent applicants enjoy a presumption that their applications cover patentable inventions.

This is bad policy. Applicants are typically the lowest-cost source of information. Given limited resources for examination, much of the attainable information about patentability is not available to the agency. This information deficit results in frequent errors during examination and concomitant social costs.

We draw from information and regulatory economics to create a 3-part framework to guide procedural reform at the Patent Office—who should provide information; how should it be provided; and when should this provision occur. We apply our framework to various legal settings to show that its principles are used widely. We then apply it to the Patent Office to suggest reforms that would require applicants to provide better information in three domains: prior art, disclosure of the invention, and the meaning and scope of the claims. These reforms will modernize procedure at the Patent Office and thereby improve patent quality.

Finally, our information economics framework pulls together disparate strands of patent scholarship. We posit that several of the biggest scholarly debates about patent quality and Patent Office reform are, at their root, dependent on the who, how, and when of examination procedures. Answering these questions helps show the aspects of the patent system for which each scholarly camps’ arguments are most persuasive.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国专利局过时的信息程序是导致大量错误专利授权的主要原因，提出了基于信息经济学的三部分框架来改革专利审查程序，要求申请人提供更好的信息以提高专利质量。
AI.research_question: 为什么专利局会授予大量不符合专利标准的错误专利？如何改革专利审查程序来提高专利质量？
AI.motivation: 专利局的信息程序自1836年以来基本未变，而技术和法律程序在其他领域已发生革命性变化，导致专利审查存在严重的信息赤字和频繁错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学和规制经济学，构建了包含谁提供信息、如何提供信息、何时提供信息的三部分框架。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和应用分析，将框架应用于不同法律环境，然后专门应用于专利局的具体改革建议。
AI.findings: 专利局过时的程序将过多信息负担放在审查员身上，而申请人作为最低成本信息来源却享有专利性推定，这导致了信息赤字和审查错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的信息经济学框架，将专利质量相关的学术争论归结为审查程序的谁、如何、何时问题，为理解专利系统提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的专利程序改革建议，要求申请人在现有技术、发明披露、权利要求含义和范围三个领域提供更好信息，以现代化专利局程序并提高专利质量。

title: The Normalization of the Far-Right: When the Salience of Victories Matters
affiliations: University of Warwick

detail.title: The Normalization of the Far-Right: When the Salience of Victories Matters
detail.abstract: Far-right voting is stigmatized, yet rising worldwide. Do signals of the far-right's popularity embolden voters to support it, even in the secrecy of the voting booth? I exploit quasiexperimental variation from the French two-round electoral system. When far-right candidates narrowly win round one-a purely symbolic victory-this brings them more votes in round two, held merely one week later. Evidence aligns with voters attending more to salient signals when they update beliefs about stigma strength. As predicted if voters attach greater weight to more salient signals, more unusual wins have larger effects. Leveraging a large corpus of newspaper articles I scraped, I show that these narrow wins attract media attention, which predicts the vote effect. Consistent with stigma erosion, this effect is specific to the far-right, larger where stigma is likely stronger, and persists in the next election. Using administrative records on campaign funding, I document similar patterns for campaign donations-acts of support that are less secret than votes and may therefore carry larger reputational costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，极右翼候选人在法国两轮选举中第一轮险胜这一象征性胜利，会显著增加其在第二轮选举中的得票率，这主要是由于媒体关注降低了选民对支持极右翼的污名感知。
AI.research_question: 极右翼受欢迎的信号是否会促使选民在投票亭中更愿意支持极右翼？
AI.motivation: 极右翼投票虽然受到污名化，但在全球范围内呈上升趋势，需要理解选民在秘密投票中支持极右翼的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于污名理论和信念更新理论，选民通过观察极右翼候选人的象征性胜利来更新对污名强度的信念。
AI.method: 利用法国两轮选举制度的准实验变异，分析极右翼候选人在第一轮险胜对第二轮投票的影响，并结合媒体数据和竞选捐款记录进行验证。
AI.findings: 极右翼候选人在第一轮险胜会显著增加第二轮得票率；媒体关注度预测了投票效应；这种效应在污名可能更强的地区更大，并持续到下一次选举；竞选捐款也显示出类似模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对污名如何影响投票行为的理解，提出了选民通过观察象征性胜利来更新污名信念的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解极右翼政治势力的崛起提供了实证证据，对选举策略和媒体在塑造政治偏好中的作用具有启示意义。

detail.title: Do Salary History Bans Mitigate Discrimnatory Hiring Practices?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston Univ. School of Law Research Paper No. 25-31
publicationDetails.journalName: Boston University School of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many states and localities have adopted salary history bans in recent years. The goal of these bans is to stop the use of a worker’s past salary to help formulate a starting salary for that worker at a new workplace. Advocates of the bans strive to diminish gender discrimination in the workplace and in particular to reduce the gender pay gap. The theory behind the ban is that on average women have a weaker salary history than men in part because of discrimination, and the use of salary history at a new employer perpetuates the effect of earlier discrimination. A growing body of empirical evidence supports the view that salary history bans work. Newly hired women in jurisdictions that implement a ban earn significantly more than newly hired women in other jurisdictions. Importantly, but less noticed, there is also evidence that salary history bans help to close the racial pay gap as well. We conclude with a discussion of the policy implications we draw from research on salary history bans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究薪资历史禁令对缩小性别和种族薪酬差距的影响。研究发现，实施薪资历史禁令的地区，新入职女性的收入显著高于其他地区，且该政策也有助于缩小种族薪酬差距。
AI.research_question: 薪资历史禁令是否有效缩小性别和种族薪酬差距？
AI.motivation: 许多州和地方政府近年来采纳了薪资历史禁令，旨在通过禁止使用员工过往薪资来确定新工作起薪，减少职场性别歧视和薪酬差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理论基础是：平均而言，女性因歧视而拥有较弱的薪资历史，在新雇主使用薪资历史会延续先前歧视的影响。
AI.method: 基于实证研究证据分析薪资历史禁令的效果。
AI.findings: 实施薪资历史禁令的地区，新入职女性收入显著高于其他地区；该政策也有助于缩小种族薪酬差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了薪资历史禁令理论的有效性，证明禁止使用过往薪资可以打破歧视的延续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了支持薪资历史禁令的实证依据，有助于推动缩小薪酬差距的政策实施。

publicationDetails.detailsText: As an Economic Policy Officer with a Master’s in Development Economics, I specialize in crafting analytical reports and translating complex economic data into actionable insights. My experience spans environmental policy, energy efficiency, and financial modeling.

detail.abstract:
This study examines the relationship between currency misalignments and climate policy effectiveness, specifically focusing on their impact on greenhouse gas emissions and renewable energy consumption. Using data from 30 countries between 1991 and 2018, the research applies fixed-effects and generalized method of moments (GMM) models to analyze how exchange rate misalignments interact with trade, foreign direct investment (FDI), and environmental outcomes.

The findings show that currency overvaluation tends to increase emissions and hinder renewable energy adoption, especially in developing and resource-dependent countries. Additionally, the study highlights the role of governance, fiscal rules, and trade openness in shaping these effects. The research also reveals regional differences, with developed countries using strong institutions to support cleaner transitions. The study concludes with policy recommendations, including stabilizing exchange rates, strengthening governance, and aligning economic policies with climate goals to promote sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了汇率失调与气候政策有效性之间的关系，发现货币高估会增加温室气体排放并阻碍可再生能源采用，特别是在发展中国家和资源依赖型国家。良好的治理、财政规则和贸易开放度能够调节这些影响，发达国家通过强健制度支持清洁转型。

AI.motivation: 理解汇率失调与气候政策之间的相互作用，为制定更有效的环境经济政策提供依据。

AI.method: 使用1991-2018年30个国家的数据，采用固定效应模型和广义矩估计(GMM)模型分析汇率失调与贸易、外国直接投资及环境结果的关系
AI.findings: 货币高估会增加排放并阻碍可再生能源采用；治理质量、财政规则和贸易开放度影响这些效应；发达国家通过强健制度支持清洁转型

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or conflicting interests related to the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: "Ethical approval was not required for this paper as it is an analytical study based on public domain data and literature review, and does not involve human subjects, patients, or ethical experimentation.

detail.abstract: In today's interconnected world, nations strive to strengthen their bilateral relations and achieve shared development through economic diplomacy. In this context, the Islamic economy, particularly the global Halal trade sector, emerges as a powerful tool to deepen ties and foster international cooperation, especially among Muslim-majority nations. This article focuses on the promising and largely untapped relationship between Indonesia, the world's largest Muslim-majority country and a leader in the Islamic economy, and Nigeria, Africa's largest economy with a significant Muslim population. This study argues that Indonesia's strategic leveraging of its advanced Halal sector as a diplomatic and investment tool in Nigeria can establish a robust new model for South-South cooperation, directly supporting Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in both nations.

title: Passive Growth, Active Response: The Effect of Indexing on Informed Trading
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis, University of Pennsylvania - Wharton School and

detail.title: Passive Growth, Active Response: The Effect of Indexing on Informed Trading
detail.abstract: Our paper shows that greater index ownership of a stock is associated with the average active fund trade in that stock appearing more informed. At the extensive margin, less-informed active funds are more likely to exit positions when index ownership increases in a stock. At the intensive margin, the remaining active funds tend to execute more informed trades in the stock, and this increase in informed trading is larger when the value of stock-specific information is greater. Our findings provide evidence that endogenous responses by active funds likely explain the lack of evidence that indexing negatively impacts stock price informativeness.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，指数基金持股比例越高，主动基金在该股票上的交易表现越有信息优势。信息较少的主动基金更可能退出，而留下的主动基金执行更明智的交易，这种效应在股票特定信息价值较高时更明显。
AI.research_question: 指数基金持股如何影响主动基金交易的信息含量？
AI.motivation: 检验指数基金是否对股票价格信息效率产生负面影响，以及主动基金如何应对指数化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论和信息不对称理论，分析指数基金与主动基金的互动机制。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用基金持股数据和交易数据，检验指数所有权与主动基金交易信息含量的关系。
AI.findings: 指数所有权增加导致信息较少的主动基金退出，留下的主动基金交易更明智，且股票特定信息价值高时效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 解释了为什么指数化未损害股票价格信息效率，提出了主动基金内生化反应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解指数基金与主动基金的互动提供实证依据，支持市场信息效率的维持机制。

title: Tactictal Asset Allocations of Large Asset Managers
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School - Department of Finance

detail.title: Tactictal Asset Allocations of Large Asset Managers
detail.abstract: Collecting market outlooks of asset managers, I study short-term expectations that summarize the relative risk and return attractiveness across asset classes. These tactical asset allocation views are reflected in positioning data from a survey of fund managers, in the time-series asset allocations of mutual funds, and in futures positioning. Allocation mutual funds reduce their equity portfolio weights by two to three percentage points when managers' views on equities decrease from "overweight" to "underweight" relative to their strategic asset allocations. Prompting a large-language model to infer expectations about macroeconomic fundamentals from the text-based outlooks, such a repositioning happens whenever the perceived growth outlook deteriorates.

title: Product and Process Innovation in the U.S. from 1980-2015 and Over the Firm's Life Cycle

detail.title: Product and Process Innovation in the U.S. from 1980-2015 and Over the Firm's Life Cycle
detail.abstract: This paper uses machine learning techniques to classify patent claims as product or process innovations. I document that the overall process share of innovation was on a secular decline from 1980-2015. I find that the process share is low at the beginning of a firm's product life cycle, peaks in the middle before plateauing at an intermediate level at the end of the life cycle. Firm size is positively associated with the process share of innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文使用机器学习技术将专利权利要求分类为产品或工艺创新，发现1980-2015年间工艺创新的总体份额呈现长期下降趋势。研究发现工艺份额在企业产品生命周期初期较低，中期达到峰值，然后在生命周期末期稳定在中等水平。企业规模与工艺创新份额呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 专利权利要求中产品创新与工艺创新的分布模式及其随时间、企业生命周期和企业规模的变化规律是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解不同类型创新（产品创新vs工艺创新）的分布模式及其影响因素，有助于更深入地认识创新活动的本质特征和演变规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产品生命周期理论、企业规模与创新关系理论，以及专利分类理论框架。
AI.method: 采用机器学习技术对专利权利要求进行自动分类，结合统计分析考察1980-2015年间的时间趋势、企业生命周期效应和企业规模效应。
AI.findings: 1) 1980-2015年间工艺创新份额呈现长期下降趋势；2) 工艺份额在企业产品生命周期中呈倒U型模式：初期低、中期高、末期稳定在中等水平；3) 企业规模与工艺创新份额正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同类型创新在企业生命周期中演变模式的理解，验证了企业规模对创新类型选择的影响，为创新分类理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业创新战略制定提供参考，帮助政策制定者更好地理解不同类型创新的发展规律，为专利分类和评估提供技术方法支持。

title: Dual Lines of Defense in the AI Era of Governance: Redefining the Self-Learning Internal Audit and the Certification Audit on Quality Culture
affiliations: Mirai Quality Research Institute

detail.title: Dual Lines of Defense in the AI Era of Governance: Redefining the Self-Learning Internal Audit and the Certification Audit on Quality Culture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants or animals performed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This paper aims to redefine the ideal relationship between two entities: the internal audit, which is becoming increasingly sophisticated and self-learning through the adoption of AI technology, and the ISO certification audit, which has been criticized for its formalism and functional decline. We propose "quality culture," a concept expected to be introduced in the next revision of ISO 9001, as a new interface to resolve the functional divergence between them. 

Design/methodology/approach: This conceptual study is based on the author's prior research (e.g., AI-augmented internal audits, the dual triangle model of misconduct). It clearly distinguishes between an organization's guiding philosophy (TM: Total Management) and the mechanisms for its implementation (IMS: Integrated Management System). The paper functionally separates the roles of internal and external audits: the internal audit verifies whether the IMS effectively realizes the TM, while the certification audit ensures that the IMS incorporates a mechanism to improve the TM (i.g., quality culture). Based on this separation, their complementary relationship is discussed. 

Findings: The certification audit should not directly assess the quality culture itself—a component of the TM—but rather should verify whether "a mechanism for continuously improving the organization's quality culture is incorporated into the IMS and is functioning effectively." A healthy quality culture (TM) is an essential foundation for both "profit acquisition (offense)" and "loss prevention (defense)." Verifying this mechanism (IMS) externally can function as healthy pressure on top management. Consequently, the internal audit (as the first line of defense) and the certification audit (as the second line of defense) form complementary "dual lines of defense" in the AI era of governance. 

Originality/value: The novelty of this paper lies in its redefinition of internal and external audits as a functionally differentiated, complementary relationship from the perspectives of TM (philosophy) and IMS (mechanism). Its originality is particularly evident in positioning "quality culture," a core theme of the next ISO revision, as part of the TM, linking it to the two pillars of management (profit acquisition and loss prevention), and proposing a concrete role for certification audits that overcomes their structural limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了内部审计与ISO认证审计的关系，提出以"质量文化"作为新接口来解决两者功能分歧，构建了在AI时代治理中的互补"双重防线"机制。
AI.research_question: 如何重新定义AI增强的内部审计与ISO认证审计之间的理想关系，以解决它们的功能分歧？
AI.motivation: 内部审计因采用AI技术而日益复杂和自主学习，而ISO认证审计则因形式主义和功能衰退而受到批评，两者之间存在功能分歧需要解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全面管理（TM）和集成管理系统（IMS）的区分，以及作者先前关于AI增强内部审计和不当行为双三角模型的研究。
AI.method: 概念性研究，基于作者先前研究，功能性地分离内部审计和外部审计的角色。
AI.findings: 认证审计不应直接评估质量文化本身，而应验证"持续改进组织质量文化的机制是否纳入IMS并有效运行"；内部审计和认证审计在AI时代治理中形成互补的"双重防线"。
AI.theory_contributions: 从TM（哲学）和IMS（机制）的角度重新定义了内部和外部审计的功能差异化互补关系，将"质量文化"定位为TM的一部分，并将其与管理两大支柱（利润获取和损失预防）联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为认证审计提出了具体的角色定位，克服其结构性限制，为组织在AI时代的治理提供了实用的双重防线机制。

title: Knowledge without Borders: Cross-Region Innovation Spillover within Business Groups
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Southwest University of Finance and Economics, Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University,  and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Knowledge without Borders: Cross-Region Innovation Spillover within Business Groups
detail.abstract: Although place-based innovation policies typically focus on specific regions, policy effects can spill over through particular networks. However, the evidence of such innovation spillover remains sparse. Utilizing the staggered establishment of national high-tech zones (HTZs) in China as a quasi-natural experiment, we investigate innovation spillover across regions through business groups. We find that the establishment of HTZs spurs corporate innovation not only in subsidiaries in targeted regions but also in subsidiaries in non-targeted regions. Specifically, for subsidiaries in non-HTZ regions, there is an average increase in innovation of 8.2%. Our results suggest that the spillover effect is not influenced by geographic distance, but is driven 1) by the internal knowledge market, which facilitates knowledge sharing through collaborations with inventors who have filed patents in HTZs, and 2) by citing patents held by targeted subsidiaries within the same business groups in HTZs. Besides, remaining inventors in subsidiaries become more productive due to inter-firm knowledge spillovers. The effect is stronger when the firms in targeted regions possess higher relative power within business groups and maintain internal managerial linkages with treated subsidiaries. Overall, this study sheds light on the significance of knowledge sharing and collaboration within business groups in driving innovation and fostering positive externalities beyond geographic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国国家级高新技术开发区的设立作为准自然实验，研究发现高新区的设立不仅促进了目标区域子公司的创新，还通过企业集团内部网络对非目标区域子公司产生了8.2%的创新溢出效应。这种溢出效应不受地理距离影响，而是通过内部知识市场和专利引用机制实现。
AI.research_question: 国家级高新技术开发区的设立是否以及如何通过企业集团网络产生跨区域的创新溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 虽然基于地点的创新政策通常关注特定区域，但政策效应可能通过特定网络产生溢出，然而此类创新溢出效应的证据仍然稀缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业集团内部知识市场理论、知识溢出理论、网络效应理论
AI.method: 利用中国国家级高新技术开发区设立的准自然实验，采用双重差分方法分析创新溢出效应
AI.findings: 1) 高新区设立使非目标区域子公司创新平均增加8.2%；2) 溢出效应不受地理距离影响；3) 通过内部知识市场（与在HTZ申请专利的发明人合作）和引用目标区域子公司专利实现；4) 剩余发明人因企业间知识溢出而更高效；5) 目标区域企业在集团内相对权力越大、与处理子公司保持内部管理联系时效应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业集团内部知识共享和协作在驱动创新和超越地理边界产生正外部性方面的重要性，拓展了创新溢出理论在网络环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的区域创新政策提供了实证依据，强调了考虑企业集团网络结构的重要性，有助于最大化政策溢出效应
